original: ñ: yac cāsti tat pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyata eva; yathā ghaṭaḥ / aṇavo 'pi hy apratyakṣāh; kim.tu ghaṭādi.kāryatayā pariṇatās te pratyakṣatvam upayānti; na punar evam ātmā kadācid api pratyakṣa.bhāvam upagacchati; ato 'trātyanta.iti viśeṣaṇam iti na paramāṇubhir vyabhicāra iti /
analyzed: yat ca asti tat pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate eva yathā ghaṭaḥ hi apratyakṣāḥ kim tu ghaṭa ādi kāryatayā pariṇatāḥ te pratyakṣa tvam upayānti na punar evam ātmā kadācid api pratyakṣa bhāvam upagacchati viśeṣaṇam iti na paramāṇubhiḥ vyabhicāraḥ iti

original: ñ99: tathā nāpy anumānam bhūtavyati.riktātmasadbhāve pravartate; tasyāpramāṇatvāt; pramāṇatve vā pratyakṣa.bādhitapakṣaprayogānantaram prayuktatvena hetoḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt / śarīravyatiriktātmapakṣo hi pratyakṣeṇaiva bādhyate /
analyzed: tathā na api anumānam bhūta vyatirikta ātma sadbhāve pravartate tasya apramāṇa tvāt pramāṇa tve vā pratyakṣa bādhita pakṣa prayoga anantaram prayukta tvena hetoḥ kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa tvāt śarīra vyatirikta ātma pakṣaḥ hi pratyakṣeṇa eva bādhyate

original: ñ100: kim ca liGga.liGgi.sambandhasmaraṇapūrvakam hy anumānam / yathā -- pūrvam mahānasādāv agni.dhūmayor liGgi.liGgayor anvayavyatirekavantam avinābhāvam adhyakṣeṇa gṛhītvā tata uttara.kālam kvacit kāntāraparvatanitambādau gaganāvalambinīm dhūma.lekhām avalokya prāg.gṛhītasambandham anusmarati /
analyzed: kim  ca liGga liGgi Cp sambandha smaraṇa pūrvakam hi anumānam yathā pūrvam mahānasa ādau agni dhūmayoḥ liGgi liGgayoḥ anvaya vyatirekavantam avinābhāvam adhyakṣeṇa gṛhītvā tatas uttara kālam kvacid kāntāra parvata nitamba ādau gagana avalambinīm dhūma lekhām avalokya prāk gṛhīta sambandham anusmarati

original: ñ: tad yathā -- yatra yatra dhūmas tatra tatra vahnim adrākṣam yathā mahānasādau; dhūmaś cātra dṛśyate tasmād vahnināpi.iha bhavitavyam ity evam liGga.grahaṇasambandhasmaraṇābhyām tatra pramātā huta.bhujam avagacchati /
analyzed: tat yathā yatra yatra dhūmaḥ tatra tatra vahnim adrākṣam yathā mahānasa ādau dhūmaḥ ca atra dṛśyate tasmāt vahninā api iha bhavitavyam iti evam li ga grahaṇa sambandha smaraṇābhyām tatra pramātā hutabhujam avagacchati

original: ñ: na caivam ātmanā liGginā sārdham kasyāpi liGgasya pratyakṣeṇa sambandhaḥ siddho 'sti; yatas tat.sambandham asusmarataḥ punas tal.liGga.darśanāj jīve sa pratyayaḥ syāt /
analyzed: na ca evam ātmanā liGginā sārdham kasya api liGgasya pratyakṣeṇa sambandhaḥ siddhaḥ sti yatas tad sambandham a susmarataḥ punar tad liGga darśanāt jīve sa pratyayaḥ syāt

original: ñ: yadi punar jīva.liGgayoḥ pratyakṣataḥ sambandhas.siddhiḥ syāt; tadā jīvasyāpi pratyakṣatvāpattyānumānavaiyarthyam syāt; tat eva jīvasiddher iti /
analyzed: yadi punar jīva liGgayoḥ pratyakṣataḥ sambandhaḥ siddhiḥ syāt tadā jīvasya api pratyakṣa tva āpattyā anumāna vaiyarthyam syāt tat eva jīva siddheḥ iti

original: ñ101: na ca vaktavyam sāmānyato.dṛṣṭānumānād āditya.gativaj jīvaḥ sidhyati; yathā gatimān ādityo deśāntaraprāpti.darśanāt; devadattavad iti /
analyzed: na ca vaktavyam sāmānyatodṛṣṭa anumānāt āditya gati vat jīvaḥ sidhyati yathā gatimān ādityaḥ deśa antara prāpti darśanāt devadatta vat iti

original: ñ: yato hanta devadatte dṛṣṭānta.dharmiṇi sāmānyena deśāntaraprāptir pūrvikā pratyakṣeṇaiva niścitā sūryo 'pi tām tathā.eva pramātā sādhayati.iti yuktam /
analyzed: yatas hanta devadatte dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇi sāmānyena deśa antara prāptiḥ pūrvikā pratyakṣeṇa eva niścitā tām tathā eva pramātā sādhayati iti yuktam

original: ñ: na caivam atra kvacid api dṛṣṭānte jīvasattvenāvinābhūtaḥ ko 'pi hetur adhyakṣeṇopalakṣyata ity ato na sāmānyato.dṛṣṭād apy anumānāt tad.gatir iti /
analyzed: na ca evam atra kvacid api dṛṣṭānte jīva sattvena avinābhūtaḥ kaḥ pi hetuḥ adhyakṣeṇa upalakṣyate iti atas na sāmānyatodṛṣṭāt api anumānāt tad gatiḥ iti

original: ñ: tathā nāpy āgama.gamya ātmā / avisamvādi.vacanāptapraṇītatvena hy āgamasya prāmāṇyam / na caivam.bhūtam avisamvādi.vacanam kamcanāpy āptam upalabhāmahe yasyātmā pratyakṣa iti /
analyzed: tathā na api āgama gamyaḥ ātmā avisamvādi vacana āpta praṇīta tvena hi āgamasya prāmāṇyam na ca evambhūtam avisamvādi vacanam kamcana api āptam upalabhāmahe yasya ātmā pratyakṣaḥ iti

original: ñ: anupalabhamānāś ca katham āthānam vipralabhemahi / kim ca; āgamāś ca sarve aprasparaviruddhaprarūpiṇaḥ /
analyzed: an upalabhamānāḥ ca katham āthānam vipralabhemahi kim ca āgamāḥ ca sarve a praspara viruddha prarūpiṇaḥ

original: ñ: tataś ca kaḥ pramāṇa kaś cāpramāṇam iti samdeha.dāvānala.jvālāvalīḍham evāgamasya prāmāṇyam / tataś ca nāgamaprāmāṇyād apy ātmasiddhiḥ 3/
analyzed: tatas ca kaḥ pramāṇa kaḥ ca apramāṇam iti samdeha dāva anala jvālā avalīḍham eva āgamasya prāmāṇyam tatas ca na āgama prāmāṇyāt api ātma siddhiḥ

original: ñ: tathā nopamānapramāṇopameyo 'py ātmā / tathā hi yathā gaus tathā gavaya ityādāv iva sādṛśyam samnikṣṛṭe.arthe buddhim utpādayati /
analyzed: tathā na upamāna pramāṇa upameyaḥ pi ātmā tathā hi yathā gauḥ tathā gavayaḥ ityādau iva sādṛśyam samnikṣṭearthe buddhim utpādayati

original: ñ: na cātra tri.bhuvane.api kaścanātmasadṛśapadārtho 'sti yad.darśanād ātmānam avagacchāmaḥ /
analyzed: na ca atra tribhuvane api kaścana ātma sadṛśa padārthaḥ sti yad darśanāt ātmānam avagacchāmaḥ

original: ñ: nanu kālākāśa.dig.ādayo jīva.tulyā vidyanta eva.iti cen na; teṣām api vivādāspadī.bhūtatvena tad.amhri.baddhatvāt 4/
analyzed: nanu kāla ākāśa diś ādayaḥ jīva tulyāḥ vidyante eva eti ced na teṣām api vivāda āspadībhūta tvena tad amhri baddha tvāt

original: ñ104: tathārthāapattir.sādhyo 'pi nātmā / na hi dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā ko 'py artha ātmānam antareṇa nopapadyate; yad.balāt tam sādhayāmaḥ /
analyzed: na ātmā na hi dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaḥ vā kaḥ pi arthaḥ ātmānam antareṇa na upapadyate yad balāt tam sādhayāmaḥ

original: ñ105: tataḥ sad.upalambhakapramāṇaviṣayātītatvāt tat.pratiṣedhasādhakābhāvākhyapramāṇaviṣayī.kṛta eva jīva iti sthitam /
analyzed: tatas sat upalambhaka pramāṇa viṣaya atīta tvāt tad pratiṣedha sādhaka abhāva ākhya pramāṇa viṣayīkṛtaḥ eva jīvaḥ iti sthitam

original: ñ106: atra pratividhīyate / yat tāvad uktam ''iha kāyākārapariṇatāni bhūtāny evopalabhyante na punas tad.vyatirikta ātmā; tat.sadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt'' ityādi; tad.asamīkṣitābhidhānam; pratyakṣasyaiva tat.sadbhāve pramāṇasya sadbhāvāt
analyzed: atra pratividhīyate yat tāvat uktam iha kāya ākāra pariṇatāni bhūtāni eva upalabhyante na punar tad vyatiriktaḥ ātmā tad sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt ityādi tat asamīkṣita abhidhānam pratyakṣasya eva tad sadbhāve pramāṇasya sadbhāvāt

original: ñ: tathā hi -- ''sukham aham anubhavāmi'' ity anyonyavivikta.jñeya.jñātṛ.jñānollekhī pratiprāṇi svasamvedyaḥ pratyayo jāyamanaḥ samvedyate /
analyzed: tathā hi sukham aham anubhavāmi iti anyonya vivikta jñeya jñātṛ jñāna ullekhī pratiprāṇi sva samvedyaḥ pratyayaḥ jāyamanaḥ samvedyate

original: ñ: na cāyam mithyā; bādhakābhāvāt / nāpi samdigdhah; ubhaya.koṭi.samsparśābhāvāt /
analyzed: na ca ayam mithyā bādhaka abhāvāt na api samdigdhaḥ ubhaya koṭi samsparśa abhāvāt

original: ñ: na ca.ittham.bhūtasyānālambanatvam yuktam; rūpādi.jñānānām apy anālambanatvaprasaGgāt /
analyzed: na ca ettham bhūtasya anālambana tvam yuktam rūpa ādi jñānānām api anālambana tva prasaGgāt

original: ñ: nāpi śarīrālambanatvam; bahih.karaṇanirapekṣāntah.karaṇavyāpāreṇotpatteḥ /
analyzed: na api śarīra ālambana tvam bahihkaraṇa nirapekṣa antahkaraṇa vyāpāreṇa utpatteḥ

original: ñ: na khalu śarīram ittham.bhūtāham.pratyayavedyam; bahih.karaṇaviṣayatvāt /
analyzed: na khalu śarīram ittham bhūta ahampratyaya vedyam bahihkaraṇa viṣaya tvāt

original: ñ: ataḥ śarīrātiriktaḥ kaścid etasyālambana.bhūto jñānavān artho 'bhyupagantavyah; tasyaiva jñātṛtvaupapatteḥ / sa ca jīva eva.iti siddhaḥ svasamvedanapratyakṣa.lakṣya ātmā /
analyzed: atas śarīra atiriktaḥ kaścid etasya ālambana bhūtaḥ jñānavān arthaḥ bhyupagantavyaḥ tasya eva jñātṛ tva aupapatteḥ sa ca jīvaḥ eva eti siddhaḥ sva samvedana pratyakṣa lakṣyaḥ ātmā

original: ñ107: tathā yad apy ayuktam 'cetanā.yogena sacetanātvāt śarīrasyaivāham.pratyayah' ityādi; tad api pralāpamātram; yataś cetanāyoge.api svayam cetanasyaivāham.pratyayotpādo yuktah; na tv acetanasya yathā paraḥ sahasrapradīpaprabhā.yoge.api svayam aprakāśasvarūpasya ghaṭasya prakāśakatvam na dṛṣṭam kim.tu pradīpasyaiva /
analyzed: tathā yat api ayuktam cetanā yogena sa cetanā tvāt śarīrasya eva ahampratyayaḥ ityādi tat api pralāpa mātram yatas cetanā yoge api svayam cetanasya eva ahampratyaya utpādaḥ yuktaḥ na tu acetanasya yathā paraḥ sahasra pradīpa prabhā yoge api svayam aprakāśa svarūpasya ghaṭasya prakāśaka tvam na dṛṣṭam kim tu pradīpasya eva

original: ñ: evam cetanāyoge.api svayam acetanasya dehasya jñātṛtvam kim.tv ātmana eva.iti tasyaiva cāham.pratyayotpādaḥ /
analyzed: evam cetanā yoge api svayam acetanasya dehasya jñātṛ tvam kim tu ātmanaḥ eva eti tasya eva ca ahampratyaya utpādaḥ

original: ñ108: yo 'pi 'sthūlo 'ham kṛśo 'ham' ityādi.pratyayaḥ samullasati, so 'py ātmopakārakatvena śarīre jāyamāna aupacārika eva; atyantopkārake bhṛtye 'aham evāyam' iti pratyayavat /
analyzed: yaḥ pi sthūlaḥ ham kṛśaḥ ham ityādi pratyayaḥ samullasati saḥ u pi ātma upakāraka tvena śarīre jāyamāna aupacārikaḥ eva atyanta upkārake bhṛtye aham eva ayam iti pratyaya vat

original: ñ109: tathā 'śarīrasyaiva caitanyam prati kartṛtvam' ityādi yad apy avādi vādi.bruveṇa; tad.apy unmattavacanaracanāmātram eva; cetanāyāḥ śarīreṇa sahānvyavyatirekābhāvāt /
analyzed: tathā śarīrasya eva caitanyam prati kartṛ tvam ityādi yat api avādi vādibruveṇa tat api unmatta vacana racanā mātram eva cetanāyāḥ śarīreṇa

original: ñ: mattamūrcchitaprasuptānām tādṛśa.śarīrasadbhāve.api na tathā.vidham caitanyam upalabhyate /
analyzed: matta mūrcchita prasuptānām tādṛśa śarīra sadbhāve api na tathāvidham caitanyam upalabhyate

original: ñ: dṛśyate ca keṣāmcit kṛśatara.śarīrāṇām api cetanā.prakarṣah; keṣāmcit sthūla.dehānām api tad.apakarṣaḥ /
analyzed: dṛśyate ca keṣāmcid kṛśatara śarīrāṇām api cetanā prakarṣaḥ keṣāmcid sthūla dehānām api tad apakarṣaḥ

original: ñ: tato na tad.anvayavyatirekānuvidhāyi caitanyam; ato na tat.kkāryam.
analyzed: tatas na tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi caitanyam atas na tat kkāryam

original: ñ110: kim ca; na hi caitanyasya bhūta.kāryatve kim api pramāṇam upalabhāmahe / tathā hi -- na tāvat pratyakṣam; atīndriyaviṣaye tad.apravartanāt /
analyzed: kim ca na hi caitanyasya bhūta kārya tve kim api pramāṇam upalabhāmahe tathā hi na tāvat pratyakṣam atīndriya viṣaye tad apravartanāt

original: ñ: na hy utpannam anutpannam vā caitanyam bhūtānām kāryam iti pratyakṣavyāpāram upaiti; tasya sva.yogyasamnihitārtha.grahaṇarūpatvāt; caitanyasya cāmūrtatvena tad.ayogyatvāt /
analyzed: na hi utpannam anutpannam vā caitanyam bhūtānām kāryam iti pratyakṣa vyāpāram upaiti tasya sva yogya samnihita artha grahaṇa rūpa tvāt caitanyasya ca amūrta tvena tad ayogya tvāt

original: ñ: na ca 'bhūtānām aham kāryam' ity evam ātmaviṣayam bhūta.kāryatvam pratyakṣam avagantum alam; kārya.kāraṇa.bhāvasyānvayavyatirekasamadhigamyatvāt /
analyzed: na ca bhūtānām aham kāryam iti evam ātma viṣayam bhūta kārya tvam pratyakṣam avagantum alam kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya anvaya vyatireka samadhigamya tvāt

original: ñ: na ca bhūta.caitanyavyatiriktaḥ kaścid anvayī tad.ubhayānvayavyatireka jñātābhyupagamyate; ātmasiddhi.prasaGgāt /
analyzed: na ca bhūta caitanya vyatiriktaḥ kaścid anvayī ātma siddhi prasaGgāt

original: ñ111: tathā nānumānenāpi caitanyasya bhūta.kāryatvam pratīyate; tasyānabhyupagamāt; 'pratyakṣam evaikam pramāṇam nānyat' [  ] iti vacanāt /
analyzed: tathā na anumānena api caitanyasya bhūta kārya tvam pratīyate tasya anabhyupagamāt pratyakṣam eva ekam pramāṇam na anyat iti vacanāt

original: ñ: abhyupagame.api na tato vivakṣitārthapratīti.siddhiḥ /
analyzed: abhyupagame api na tatas vivakṣita artha pratīti siddhiḥ

original: ñ112: nanu kāryākārapariṇatebhyo bhūtebhyaś caitanyam tam utpadyate, tad.bhāva eva caitanya.bhāvāt; madyāGgebhyo 'mada.śaktivat' ityādy.anumānād bhavaty eva caitanyam bhūt.kāryatvasiddhir iti cen na; tad.bhāva eva tad.bhāvād iti hetor anaikāntikatvāt; mṛtāvasthāyām tad.bhāve.api caitanyasyābhāvāt /
analyzed: nanu kārya ākāra pariṇatebhyaḥ bhūtebhyaḥ caitanyam tam utpadyate tad bhāvaḥ eva caitanya bhāvāt madya āgebhyaḥ mada śakti vat ityādi anumānāt bhavati eva caitanyam bhūtkāryatva siddhiḥ iti ced na tad bhāve eva tad bhāvāt iti hetoḥ anaikāntika tvāt mṛta avasthāyām tad bhāve api caitanyasya abhāvāt

original: ñ113: syād etat; pṛthivy.ap.tejo.vāyu.lakṣaṇa.bhūta.catuṣṭayasamudāya.janyam hi caitanyam; na ca mṛta.śarīre vāyur asti; tatas tad.abhāvāt tatra caitanyābhāva iti na tena vyabhicārah; atrocyate -- sati śuṣire tatra vātaḥ sutarām sambhāvyata eva /
analyzed: syāt etat pṛthivī ap tejaḥ vāyu lakṣaṇa bhūta catuṣṭaya samudāya janyam hi caitanyam na ca mṛta śarīre vāyuḥ asti tatas tad abhāvāt tatra caitanya abhāvaḥ iti na tena vyabhicāraḥ atra ucyate sati śuṣire tatra vātaḥ sutarām sambhāvyate eva

original: ñ: kim cayadi tatra vāyu.vaikalyāc caitanyasyābhāvaḥ tato bastyādibhiḥ sampādite vāyau tatra caitanyam upalabhyeta; na ca tatra tat.sampādite.api vāyau caitanyam upalabhyate /
analyzed: kim ca yadi tatra vāyu vaikalyāt caitanyasya abhāvaḥ tatas vasti ādibhiḥ sampādite vāyau tatra caitanyam upalabhyeta na ca tatra tad sampādite api vāyau caitanyam upalabhyate

original: ñ114: atha prāṇāpāna.lakṣaṇavāyor abhāvān na tatra caitanyam iti cen na; anvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvābhāvān na prāṇāpānavāyoś caitanyam prati hetutā /
analyzed: atha prāṇa apāna lakṣaṇa vāyoḥ abhāvāt na tatra caitanyam iti ced na anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tva abhāvāt na prāṇa apāna vāyoḥ caitanyam prati hetutā

original: ñ: yato maraṇādy.avasthāyām pracuratara.dīrgha.śvāsocchāsasambhave.api kasyāpi yogino niruddhaprāṇāpānasyāpi paramaprakarṣaprāptaś cetanā.upacayaḥ samupalabhyate /
analyzed: yatas maraṇa ādi avasthāyām pracuratara dīrgha śvāsa ucchāsa sambhave api kasya api yoginaḥ niruddha prāṇa apānasya api parama prakarṣa prāptaḥ cetanā upacayaḥ samupalabhyate

original: ñ115: atha tejaso 'bhāvān na mṛtāvasthāyām caitanyam iti cet; tarhi tatra tejasy upanīte sati katham na cetanā.upalabhyate
analyzed: atha tejasaḥ bhāvāt na mṛta avasthāyām caitanyam iti ced tarhi tatra tejasi upanīte sati katham na cetanā upalabhyate

original: ñ116: kim ca; mṛtāvasthāyām yadi vāyu.tejasor abhāvena caitanyābhāvo 'bhyupagamyate; tarhi mṛta.śarīre kiyad.velānantaram samutpannānām kṛmyādīnām katham caitanyam / tato yat.kimcid etat /
analyzed: kim ca mṛta avasthāyām yadi vāyu tejasoḥ abhāvena caitanya abhāvaḥ bhyupagamyate tarhi mṛta śarīre kiyat velā anantaram samutpannānām kṛmi ādīnām katham caitanyam tatas yat kimcid etat

original: ñ117: kim ca; na caitanyam bhūtamātra.kāraṇam; tathā sati caitanyasya bhūtamātra.janyasvabhāvatvāt teṣām api taj.jananasvabhāvatvāt sarvadā sarvatra ghaṭādau puruṣādiṣv iva vyakta.caitanyotpādo bhavet; nimittāviśeṣāt / evam ca ghaṭādi.puruṣayor aviśeṣaḥ syāt /
analyzed: kim ca na caitanyam bhūtamātra kāraṇam tathā sati caitanyasya bhūtamātra janya svabhāva tvāt teṣām api tad janana svabhāva tvāt sarvadā sarvatra ghaṭa ādau puruṣa ādiṣu iva vyakta caitanya utpādaḥ bhavet nimitta aviśeṣāt evam ca ghaṭa ādi puruṣayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ syāt

original: ñ118: nanu 'kāyākārapariṇāmaprāṇāpānaparigrahavadbhyo bhūtebhyaś caitanyam upalabhyate' iti vacanān na pūrvokto 'tiprasaGga.dośāvakāśa iti cet tan na; tvan.mate kāyākārapariṇāmasyaivānupapadyamānatvāt /
analyzed: nanu kāya ākāra pariṇāma prāṇa apāna parigrahavadbhyaḥ bhūtebhyaḥ caitanyam upalabhyate iti vacanāt na pūrvokta uti prasaGga dośa avakāśaḥ iti ced tat na tvad mate kāya ākāra pariṇāmasya eva anupapadyamāna tvāt

original: ñ: tathā hi -- sa kāyākārapariṇāmaḥ kim pṛthivyādi.bhūtamātranibandhanah; uta vastv antaranimitta utāhetuka iti trayī gatiḥ /
analyzed: tathā hi sa kāya ākāra pariṇāmaḥ kim pṛthivī ādi bhūta mātra nibandhanaḥ uta vastu antara nimittaḥ uta ahetukaḥ iti trayī gatiḥ

original: ñ: tatra na tāvad ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ kakṣī.karaṇīyaḥ pṛthivyādi.sattāyāḥ sarvatra sadbhāvāt sarvatrāpi kāyākārapariṇāmaprasaGgaḥ /
analyzed: tatra na tāvat ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ kakṣīkaraṇīyaḥ pṛthivī ādi sattāyāḥ sarvatra sadbhāvāt sarvatra api kāya ākāra pariṇāma prasaGgaḥ

original: ñ119: tathā.vidhasādhyādi.bhāvasahakāri.kāraṇavaikalyāan na sarvatra tat.rpasaGga iti cet tan na; yataḥ so 'pi sāmyādi.bhāvo na vastv.antar.nimittah; tattvāntarāpatti.prasaGgāt; kim.tu pṛthivyādi.satāmātranimittah; atas tasyāpi 'sarvatrāpy aviśeṣeṇa bhāvaprasaGgāt kutaḥ sahakāri.kāraṇavailayam iti /
analyzed: tathāvidha sādhya ādi bhāva sahakāri kāraṇa vaikalyāt na sarvatra tad pasaGgaḥ iti ced tat na yatas saḥ pi sāmya ādi bhāvaḥ na vastu antar nimittaḥ tattva antara āpatti prasaGgāt kimtu pṛthivī ādi satā mātra nimittaḥ atas tasya api sarvatra api aviśeṣeṇa bhāva prasaGgāt kutas sahakāri kāraṇa vailayam iti

original: ñ: atha vastv.antaranimitta iti pakṣaḥ tad apy ayuktam; tathābhyupagame jīvasiddhi.prasaGgāt /
analyzed: atha vastu antara nimittaḥ iti pakṣaḥ tat api ayuktam tathā abhyupagame jīva siddhi prasaGgāt

original: ñ: athāhetukaḥ tarhi sadā bhāvādi.prasaGgah; 'nityam sattvam asattvam vā hetor anyānapekṣaṇāt' [pravā.3.34] iti vacanāt /
analyzed: atha ahetukaḥ tarhi sadā bhāva ādi prasaGgaḥ nityam sattvam asattvam vā hetoḥ anya anapekṣaṇāt iti vacanāt

original: ñ: tan na tvan.mate kāyākārapariṇāmaḥ samgacchate / tad.abhāve tu dūrotsāritam eva prāṇāpānaparigrahavattvam amīṣām bhūtānām iti; caitanyam na bhūta.kāryam ity ato jīva.guṇa eva cetanā.ity upagantavyam /
analyzed: tat na tvad mate kāya ākāra pariṇāmaḥ samgacchate tad abhāve tu dūra utsāritam eva prāṇa apāna parigrahavat tvam amīṣām bhūtānām iti caitanyam na bhūta kāryam iti atas jīva guṇaḥ eva cetanā iti upagantavyam

original: ñ120: kim ca; guṇapratyakṣatvād ātmāpi guṇī pratyakṣa eva / prayogo yathā -- pratyakṣā ātmā; smṛti.jijñāsā.cikīrṣā.jigamiṣā.samśayādi.jñānaviśeṣāṇām tad.guṇānām svasamvedanapratyakṣatvāt /
analyzed: kim ca guṇa pratyakṣa tvāt ātmā api guṇī pratyakṣaḥ eva prayogaḥ yathā pratyakṣāḥ ātmā smṛti jijñāsā cikīrṣā jigamiṣā samśaya ādi jñāna viśeṣāṇām tad guṇānām sva samvedana pratyakṣa tvāt

original: ñ: iha ysya guṇāḥ pratyakṣāḥ sa pratyakṣo dṛṣṭah; yathā ghaṭa iti / pratyakṣa.guṇaś ca jīvah; tasmāt pratyakṣaḥ /
analyzed: iha ysya guṇāḥ pratyakṣāḥ sa pratyakṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā ghaṭaḥ iti pratyakṣa guṇaḥ ca jīvaḥ tasmāt pratyakṣaḥ

original: ñ: atrāha paraḥ -- anaikāntiko 'yam hetuh; yata ākāśa.guṇaḥ śabdaḥ pratyakṣah; na punar ākāśam; tad ayuktam; yato nākāśa.guṇaḥ śabdaḥ kim.tu pudgala.guṇah; aindriyakatvāt; rūpādivat / etac ca pudgalavicāre samarthayiṣyate /
analyzed: atra āha paraḥ anaikāntikaḥ yam hetuḥ yatas ākāśa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ pratyakṣaḥ na punar ākāśam tat ayuktam yatas na ākāśa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ kimtu pudgala guṇaḥ aindriyaka tvāt rūpa ādi vat etat ca pudgala vicāre samarthayiṣyate

original: ñ121: atrāha nanu bhavatu guṇānām pratyakṣatvāt tad.abhinnatvād guṇino 'pi pratyakṣatvam /
analyzed: atra āha nanu bhavatu guṇānām pratyakṣa tvāt tad abhinna tvāt guṇinaḥ pi pratyakṣa tvam

original: ñ: kim.tu deha eva jñānādayo guṇā upalabhyante / ataḥ sa eva teṣām guṇī yuktah; yathā rūpādīnām ghaṭaḥ /
analyzed: kim tu dehe eva jñāna ādayaḥ guṇāḥ upalabhyante atas saḥ eva teṣām guṇī yuktah yathā rūpa ādīnām ghaṭaḥ

original: ñ: prayogo yathā -- jñānādayo deha.guṇā eva; tatraivopalabhyamānatvāt; gaura.kṛśasthūratvādivat /
analyzed: prayogaḥ yathā jñāna ādayaḥ deha guṇāḥ eva tatra eva upalabhyamāna tvāt gaura kṛśa sthūra tva ādi vat

original: ñ: atrocyate -- pratyanumāna.bādhito 'yam pakṣābhāsaḥ / tac ca.idam -- dehasya guṇā jñānādayo na bhavanti; tasya mūrtatvāc cākṣuṣatvād vā; ghaṭavat / ataḥ siddho guṇapratyakṣatvād guṇī jīpo 'pi pratyakṣaḥ /
analyzed: atra ucyate pratyanumāna bādhitaḥ yam pakṣa ābhāsaḥ tat ca edam dehasya guṇāḥ jñāna ādayaḥ na bhavanti tasya mūrta tvāt cākṣuṣa tvāt vā ghaṭa vat atas siddhaḥ guṇa pratyakṣa tvāt guṇī pratyakṣaḥ

original: ñ122: tatas cāham.pratyaya.grāhyam pratyakṣam ātmānam nihnuvānasyāśrāvaṇaḥ śabda ityādivat pratyakṣaviruddho nāma pakṣābhāsaḥ /
analyzed: tatas ca aham pratyaya grāhyam pratyakṣam ātmānam nihnuvānasya aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ ityādi vat pratyakṣaviruddhaḥ nāma pakṣa ābhāsaḥ

original: ñ: tathā vakṣyamānātmāstitvānumānasadbhāvān nityaḥ śabda ityādivad anumānaviruddoho 'pi /
analyzed: tathā vakṣyamāna ātma astitva anumāna sadbhāvāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ ityādi vat pi

original: ñ: ābāla.gopālāGganā.ādi.prasikkkham cātmānam nirākurvataḥ / (?)
analyzed: ca ātmānam nirākurvataḥ

original: ñ: 'nāsti sūryaḥ prakāśa.kartā' ityādival lokaviroddaḥ / 'aham nāham' ca.iti gadataḥ 'mātā me vandhyā' ityādivat svavacanavirodhaś ca /
analyzed: na asti sūryaḥ prakāśa kartā ityādi vat loka viroddhaḥ aham na aham ca eti gadataḥ mātā me vandhyā ityādi vat sva vacana virodhaḥ ca

original: ñ: tathā pratipādita.yuktyā.ātmanaḥ svasamvedanapratyakṣatvād atyantāpratyakṣatvād iti hetur apy asiddha iti sthitam /
analyzed: tathā pratipādita yuktyā ātmanaḥ sva samvedana pratyakṣa tvāt atyanta apratyakṣa tvāt iti hetuḥ api asiddhaḥ iti sthitam

original: ñ123: tathānumāna.gamyo apy ātmā / tāni cāmūni -- jīva.śarīram prayatnavatādhiṣṭhitam; icchānuvidhāyi.kriyā.āśrayatvāt; rathavat /
analyzed: tathā anumāna gamyaḥ api ātmā tāni ca amūni jīva śarīram prayatnavatā adhiṣṭhitam icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā āśraya tvāt ratha vat

original: ñ: śrotrādīny upalabhi.sādhanāni kartṛ.prayojyāni; karaṇatvāt; vāsyādivat /
analyzed: śrotra ādīni upalabhi sādhanāni kartṛ prayojyāni karaṇa tvāt

original: ñ: dehasyāsti vidhātā; ādimat.pratiniyatākāratvāt; ghaṭavat / yat puna akartṛkam tad ādimat.pratiniyatākāram api na bhavati; yathābhravikāraḥ /
analyzed: dehasya asti vidhātā ādimat pratiniyata ākāra tvāt ghaṭa vat yat puna akartṛkam tat ādimat pratiniyata ākāram api na bhavati yathā abhra vikāraḥ

original: ñ: yaḥ sva.dehasya kartā sa jīvaḥ / pratiniyatākāratvam merv.ādīnām apy asti; na ca teṣām kaścid vidhātā.iti tair anaikāntiko hetuḥ syāt; atas tad.vyavacchedārtham ādimattvaviśeṣaṇam draṣṭavyam /
analyzed: yaḥ sva dehasya kartā sa jīvaḥ pratiniyata ākāra tvam meru ādīnām api asti na ca teṣām kaścid vidhātā iti taiḥ anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ syāt atas tad vyavaccheda artham ādimattva viśeṣaṇam draṣṭavyam

original: ñ: tathā.indriyāṇām asty adhiṣṭhātā; karaṇatvāt; yathā daṇṭa.cakrādīnām kulālo vidyamāna.bhoktṛkam śarīram bhogyatvād; bhojanavat / yaś ca bhoktā sa jīvaḥ /
analyzed: tathā indriyāṇām asti adhiṣṭhātā karaṇa tvāt yathā daṇṭa cakra ādīnām kulālaḥ vidyamāna bhoktṛkam śarīram bhogya tvāt bhojana vat yaḥ ca bhoktā sa jīvaḥ

original: ñ124: atha sādhyaviruddhasādhakatvād viruddhā evaite hetavaḥ / tathā highaṭādīnām kartṛ.ādi.rūpāḥ kumbha.kārādayo murtā anityādi.svabhāvāś ca dṛṣṭā iti /
analyzed: atha sādhya viruddha sādhaka tvāt viruddhāḥ eva ete hetavaḥ tathā hi ghaṭa ādīnām kartṛ ādi rūpāḥ kumbhakāra ādayaḥ murtāḥ anitya ādi svabhāvāḥ ca dṛṣṭāḥ iti

original: ñ: ato jīvo 'py evam.vidha eva sidhyati / etad.viparītaś ca jīva iṣṭa iti /
analyzed: atas evamvidhaḥ eva sidhyati etad viparītaḥ ca jīvaḥ iṣṭaḥ iti

original: ñ: ataḥ sādhyaviruddhasādhakatvād viruddhatvam hetūnām iti cen na; yataḥ khalu samsāriṇo jīvasyāṣṭa.karmapudgalaveṣṭitatvena saśarīratvāt kathamcin mūrtatvān nāyam doṣaḥ /
analyzed: atas sādhya viruddha sādhaka tvāt viruddha tvam hetūnām iti ced na yatas khalu samsāriṇaḥ jīvasya aṣṭa karma pudgala veṣṭita tvena sa śarīra tvāt kathamcid mūrta tvāt na ayam doṣaḥ

original: ñ125: tathā rūpādi.j;nānam kvacid āśritam guṇatvāt; rūpādivat / tathā jñānasukhādikam upādāna.kāraṇapūrvakam kāryatvād ghaṭādivat /
analyzed: tathā rūpa ādi jnānam kvacid āśritam guṇa tvāt rūpa ādi vat tathā jñāna sukha ādikam upādāna kāraṇa pūrvakam kārya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat

original: ñ: na ca śarīre tad.āśritatvasya tad.upādānatvasya ceṣṭatvāt siddhasādhanam ity abhidhātavyam; tatra tad.āśritatva.tad.upādānatvayoḥ prāk prativyūḍhatvāt /
analyzed: na ca śarīre tad āśrita tvasya tad upādāna tvasya ca iṣṭatvāt siddhasādhanam iti abhidhātavyam tatra tad āśrita tva tad upādāna tvayoḥ prāk prativyūḍha tvāt

original: ñ: tathā pratipakṣavān ayam ajīva.śabdah; vyutpattimat.śuddhapadapratiṣedhāt /
analyzed: tathā pratipakṣavān ayam ajīva śabdaḥ vyutpattimat śuddha pada pratiṣedhāt

original: ñ: yatra vyutpattimataḥ śuddhapadasya pratiṣedho dṛśyate sa partipakṣavān yathāghaṭo ghaṭapratipakṣavān /
analyzed: yatra vyutpattimataḥ śuddha padasya pratiṣedhaḥ dṛśyate sa yathā ghaṭaḥ ghaṭa pratipakṣavān

original: ñ: atra hy aghaṭaprayoge śuddhasya vyutpattimataś ca padasya pratiṣedhaḥ /
analyzed: atra hi a ghaṭa prayoge śuddhasya vyutpattimataḥ ca padasya pratiṣedhaḥ

original: ñ: ato 'vaśyam ghaṭa.lakṣaṇena pratipakṣeṇa bhāvyam / yas tu na pratipakṣavān; na tatra vyutpattimataḥ śuddhapadasya pratiṣedhah; yathākharaviṣāṇa.śabda aḍittha iti vā /
analyzed: atas vaśyam ghaṭa lakṣaṇena pratipakṣeṇa bhāvyam yaḥ tu na pratipakṣavān na tatra vyutpattimataḥ śuddha padasya yathā ākhara viṣāṇa śabdaḥ aṭ itthaḥ iti vā

original: ñ: akharaviṣāṇam ity atra kharaviṣāṇa.lakṣaṇasyāśuddhasya sāmāsikasya padasya niṣedhaḥ / atra vyutpattimattve saty api śuddhapadatvābhāvād vipakṣo nāsti /
analyzed: ñ a khara viṣāṇam iti atra khara viṣāṇa lakṣaṇasya aśuddhasya sāmāsikasya padasya niṣedhaḥ atra vyutpattimat tve sati api śuddha pada tva abhāvāt vipakṣaḥ na asti

original: ñ: aḍittha ity atra tu vyutpattimattvābhāvāt saty.api śuddhapadatve nāvaśyam ḍittha.lakṣaṇaḥ kaścit padārtho jīvavad vipakṣa.bhūto 'sti.iti /
analyzed: iti atra tu vyutpattimat tva abhāvāt sati api śuddha pada tve na avaśyam ḍittha lakṣaṇaḥ kaścid padārthaḥ jīva vat

original: ñ126: tathā sva.śarīre svasamvedanapratyakṣam ātmānam sādhayitvā para.śarīre.api sāmānyato.dṛṣṭānumānena sādhyate /
analyzed: tathā sva śarīre sva samvedana pratyakṣam ātmānam sādhayitvā para śarīre api sāmānyatodṛṣṭa anumānena sādhyate

original: ñ: yathā para.śarīre.apy asty ātmā; iṣṭāniṣṭayoḥ pravṛttinivṛtti.darśanāt; yathā sva.śarīre /
analyzed: yathā para śarīre api asti ātmā iṣṭa aniṣṭayoḥ pravṛtti nivṛtti darśanāt yathā sva śarīre

original: ñ: dṛśyete ca para.śarīra iṣṭāniṣṭayoḥ pravṛttinivṛttī; tasmāt tat.sātmakam; ātmābhāve tayor abhāvāt; yathā ghaṭa iti /
analyzed: dṛśyete ca para śarīre iṣṭa aniṣṭayoḥ pravṛtti nivṛttī tasmāt tat sātmakam ātma abhāve tayoḥ abhāvāt yathā ghaṭaḥ iti

original: ñ: etena yad uktam 'na sāmānyato.dṛṣṭānumānād apy ātmasiddhih' ityādi; tad.apy apāstam draṣṭavyam /
analyzed: etena yat uktam na sāmānyatodṛṣṭa anumānāt api ityādi tat api apāstam draṣṭavyam

original: ñ127: tathā nāsti jīva iti yo 'yam jīvaniṣedha.dhvaniḥ sa jīvāstitvenāntarīyaka eva; niṣedha.śabdatvāt /
analyzed: tathā na asti jīvaḥ iti yaḥ yam jīva niṣedha dhvaniḥ sa jīva astitvena āntarīyakaḥ eva niṣedha śabda tvāt

original: ñ: yathā nāsty atra ghaṭa iti śabdo 'nyatra ghaṭāstitvāvinābhāvy eva /
analyzed: yathā na asti atra ghaṭaḥ iti śabdaḥ nyatra ghaṭa astitva avinābhāvī eva

original: ñ: prayogaś cātra -- iha yasya niṣedhaḥ kriyate tat kvacid asty eva; yathā ghaṭādikam /
analyzed: prayogaḥ ca atra iha yasya niṣedhaḥ kriyate tat kvacid asti eva yathā ghaṭa ādikam

original: ñ: niṣidhyate ca bhavatā 'nāsti jīvah' iti vacanāt / tasmād asty evāsau / yac ca sarvathā nāsti; tasya niṣedho 'pi na dṛśyate; yathā pañca.bhūtātirikita.ṣaṣṭha.bhūtasya.iti /
analyzed: niṣidhyate ca bhavatā na asti iti vacanāt tasmāt asti eva asau yat ca sarvathā na asti tasya niṣedhaḥ na dṛśyate yathā pañcabhūta atirikita ṣaṣṭha bhūtasya eti

original: ñ: nanv asato 'pi kharaviṣāṇāder niṣedha.darśanād anaikāntiko 'yam hetur iti cen na; iha yat.kim.api vastu niṣidhyate; tasyānyatra sata eva vivakṣitasthāne samyogasamavāyasāmānyaviśeṣa.lakṣaṇam catuṣṭayam eva niṣidhyate; na tu sarvathā tad.abhāvaḥ pratipādyate /
analyzed: nanu asataḥ pi khara viṣāṇa ādeḥ niṣedha darśanāt anaikāntikaḥ yam hetuḥ iti ced na iha yat kim api vastu niṣidhyate tasya anyatra sataḥ eva vivakṣita sthāne samyoga samavāya sāmānya viśeṣa lakṣaṇam catuṣṭayam eva niṣidhyate na tu sarvathā tad abhāvaḥ pratipādyate

original: ñ: yathā nāsti gṛhe devadatta ityādiṣu 'gṛha.devadattādīnām satām eva samyogamātram niṣidhyate; na tu teṣām sarvathā.evāstitvam apākriyate /
analyzed: yathā na asti gṛhe devadattaḥ ityādiṣu gṛha devadatta ādīnām satām eva samyoga mātram niṣidhyate na tu teṣām sarvathā eva astitvam apākriyate

original: ñ: tathā nāsti kharaviṣāṇam ityādiṣu kharaviṣāṇādīnām satām eva samavāyamātram nirākriyate /
analyzed: tathā na asti khara viṣāṇam ityādiṣu khara viṣāṇa ādīnām satām eva samavāya mātram nirākriyate

original: ñ: tathā nāsty.anyaś candramā ityādiṣu vidyamānasyaiva candramaso 'nya.candraniṣedhāc candrasāmānyamātram niṣidhyate; na tu sarvathā candrābhāvaḥ pratipādyate /

original: ñ173: ayam ca kālo na nirvartakam kāraṇam nāpi pariṇāmi kāraṇam; kimtu svayam sambhavatām bhāvānām asmin kāle bhavitavyam nānyadā.ity.apekṣā.kāraṇam /

original: ñ: santo hi bhāvās tatra svayam evotpadyate vyayanty avatiṣṭhante ca / astitvam ca bhāvānām svata eva; na tu kālāpekṣam /

original: ñ: tato 'b.ādīni catur.guṇāni sparśitvāt; pṛthivīvat / tathā manaḥ sparśādimat; asarva.gata.dravyatvāt; pārthivāṇuvad iti prayogau siddhau /

original: ñ: na kevalam pudgalānām sparśādayo dharmāh; śabdādayaś ca.iti darśyate / ''śabda.bandhasaukṣmyasthaulyasamsthāna.bheda.tamaś.chāyā.tapo.dyotavantaś ca'' [tasū.5.24] pudgalāḥ /

original: ñ: atra pudgalapariṇāmāviṣkārī matupratyayo nitya.yogārtham vihitaḥ / tatra śabdo dhvaniḥ / bandhaḥ parasparāśleṣa.lakṣaṇaḥ prayogavisrasā.ādi.janita audārikādi.śarīreṣu jatu.kāṣṭhādi.śleṣavat paramāṇu.samyogajavad vā.iti /

original: ñ: nāpi parasamvedanavedyatā; nityam arūpitvena / tat katham teṣām dharmāstikāyādīnām satām sattā śraddheyā syād iti ced ucyate; pratyakṣeṇa yo 'rtho nopalabhyate sa sarvathā nāsty eva; yathā śaśaviṣāṇam ity ekāntena na mantavyam /

original: ñ: yā ca satsv abhāvānām api bhāvānām anupalabdhih; sātrāṣṭadhā bhidyate / tathā hi -- atidūrāt; atisāmīpyāt; indriya.ghātāt; manaso 'navasthānāt; saukṣmyāt; āvaraṇāt; abhibhavāt; samānābhihārāc ca.iti /

original: ñ: tathā kālaviprakarṣād bhūtā nijapūrvajādayo bhaviṣyā vā padmanābhādayo jinā nopalabhyante; abhūvan bhaviṣyanti ca te /

original: ñ: tathā svabhāvaviprakarṣān nabho.jīvapiśācādayo nopalabhyante, na ca te na santi /

original: ñ187: tathā mano 'navasthānād yathā anavasthita.cetā na paśyati / uktam ca --

original: ñ: yac ca āsām phala.bhūtam kāryam tat puṇyam pāpam cāvagantavyam; yathā kṛṣyādi.kriyāṇām śāli.yava.godhūmādikam /
analyzed: yat ca āsām phala bhūtam kāryam tat puṇyam pāpam ca avagantavyam yathā kṛṣi ādi kriyāṇām śāli yava godhūma ādikam

original: ñ218: nanu yathā kṛṣyādi.kriyā dṛṣṭa.śālyādi.phalamātreṇaivāvasitaprayogā bhavanti; tathā dānādikāḥ paśu.himsā.ādikāś ca sarvā api kriyāḥ ślāghā.ādinā māmsa.bhakṣaṇādinā ca dṛṣṭaphalamātreṇaivāvasitaprayojanā bhavantu; kim adṛṣṭa.dharmādharmaphaka.kalpena /
analyzed: nanu yathā kṛṣi ādi kriyāḥ dṛṣṭa śāli ādi phala mātreṇa eva avasita prayogāḥ bhavanti tathā dāna ādikāḥ paśu himsā ādikāḥ ca sarvāḥ api kriyāḥ ślāghā ādinā māmsa bhakṣaṇa ādinā ca dṛṣṭa phala mātreṇa eva avasita prayojanāḥ bhavantu kim adṛṣṭa dharma adharma phaka kalpena

original: ñ: loko hi prāyeṇa sarvo 'pi dṛṣṭamātraphalāsv eva kṛṣi.vāṇijya.himsā.ādi.kriyāsu pravartate; adṛṣṭaphalāsu punar dānādi.kriyāsv atyalpa eva lokaḥ pravartate na bahuḥ /
analyzed: lokaḥ hi prāyeṇa dṛṣṭa mātra phalāsu eva kṛṣi vāṇijya himsā ādi kriyāsu pravartate adṛṣṭa phalāsu punar dāna ādi kriyāsu ati alpaḥ eva lokaḥ pravartate na bahuḥ

original: ñ: tatś ca kṛṣi.himsā.ādy.śubha.kriyāṇām adṛṣṭaphalābhāvād dānādi.śubha.kriyāṇām apy adṛṣṭaphalābhāvo bhaviṣyati.iti cen na --
analyzed: tatas ca kṛṣi himsā ādi śubha kriyāṇām adṛṣṭa phala abhāvāt dāna ādi śubha kriyāṇām api adṛṣṭa phala abhāvaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced na

original: ñ: yata eva kṛṣyādy.aśubha.kriyāsu dṛṣṭaphalāsu bahavaḥ pravartante; adṛṣṭaphalāsu punar dānādi.śubha.kriyāsv atyalpa eva lokaḥ pravartate; tata eva kṛṣi.himsā.ādikā dṛṣṭaphalāḥ kriyā adṛṣṭapāparūpaphalā api pratipattavyāh; anantasamsāri.jīvasattvānyathānupapatteḥ /
analyzed: yatas eva kṛṣi ādi aśubha kriyāsu dṛṣṭa phalāsu bahavaḥ pravartante adṛṣṭa phalāsu punar dāna ādi śubha kriyāsu ati alpaḥ eva lokaḥ pravartate tatas eva kṛṣi himsā ādikāḥ dṛṣṭa phalāḥ kriyāḥ adṛṣṭa pāpa rūpa phalāḥ api pratipattavyā ah ananta samsāri jīva sattva anyathā anupapatteḥ

original: ñ: te hi kṛṣi.himsā.ādi.kriyā.nimittam anabhilaṣitam apy dṛṣṭam pāpa.lakṣaṇam phalam baddhvānantasamsāram paribhramanto 'nantā iha tiṣṭhanti /
analyzed: te hi kṛṣi himsā ādi kriyā nimittam an abhilaṣitam api dṛṣṭam pāpa lakṣaṇam phalam baddhvā ananta samsāram paribhramantaḥ nantāḥ iha tiṣṭhanti

original: ñ: yadi hi kṛṣi.himsā.ādy.aśubha.kriyāṇām adṛṣṭam pāparūpam phalam nābhyupagamyate; tadā tat.kartāro 'dṛṣṭaphalābhāvān maraṇānantaram eva sarve.apy ayatnena muktim gaccheyuḥ /
analyzed: yadi hi kṛṣi himsā ādi aśubha kriyāṇām adṛṣṭam pāpa rūpam phalam na abhyupagamyate tadā tad kartāraḥ dṛṣṭa phala abhāvāt maraṇa anantaram eva sarve api ayatnena muktim gaccheyuḥ

original: ñ: tataḥ prāyaḥ śūnya eva samsāraḥ syāt tataś ca samsāre duhkhī ko 'pi nopalabhyate /
analyzed: tatas prāyas śūnyaḥ eva samsāraḥ syāt tatas ca samsāre duhkhī na upalabhyate

original: ñ: dānādi.śubha.kriyānuṣṭhātāraḥ śubha.tat.phalavipākānubhavitāra eva kevalāḥ sarvatropalabhyate /
analyzed: dāna ādi śubha kriyā anuṣṭhātāraḥ śubha tad phala vipāka anubhavitāraḥ eva kevalāḥ sarvatra upalabhyate

original: ñ: duhkhinaś cātra bahavo dṛśyante sukhinas tv alpā eva; tena jñāyate kṛṣi.vāṇijya.himsā.ādi.kriyā.ādi.bandhano 'dṛṣṭapāparūpaphalavikāko duhkhitām; itereṣām tu dānādi.kriyā.hetuko 'dṛṣṭa.dharmarūpaphalavipāka iti /
analyzed: duhkhinaḥ ca atra bahavaḥ dṛśyante sukhinaḥ tu alpāḥ eva tena jñāyate kṛṣi vāṇijya himsā ādi kriyā ādi bandhanaḥ dṛṣṭa pāpa rūpa phala vikākaḥ duhkhi tām tu dāna ādi kriyā hetukaḥ dṛṣṭa dharma rūpa phala vipākaḥ iti

original: ñ219: vyatyayaḥ kasmān na bhavati.iti ced ucyate; aśubha.kriyā.ārambhiṇām eva ca bahutvāt śubha.kriyānuṣṭhātṛṛṇām eva ca svalpatvād iti kāraṇānumānam /
analyzed: vyatyayaḥ kasmāt na bhavati iti ced ucyate aśubha kriyā ārambhiṇām eva ca bahu tvāt śubha kriyā anuṣṭhātṛṇām eva ca su alpa tvāt iti kāraṇa anumānam

original: ñ220: atha kāryānumānam -- jīvānām ātmatvāvaśeṣe.api narapaśv.ādiṣu dehādi.vaicitryasya kāraṇam asti; kāryatvāt; yathā ghaṭasya mṛd.daṇḍa.cakra.cīvarādi.sāmagrī.kalptaḥ kulālaḥ /
analyzed: atha kārya anumānam jīvānām ātma tva avaśeṣe api nara paśu ādiṣu deha ādi vaicitryasya kāraṇam asti kārya tvāt yathā ghaṭasya mṛd daṇḍa cakra cīvara ādi sāmagrī kalptaḥ kulālaḥ

original: ñ: na ca dṛṣṭa eva mātā.pitr.ādikas tasya hetur iti vaktavyam; dṛṣṭa.hetu.sāmye.api; surūpa.itarādi.bhāvena dehādīnām vaicitrya.darśanāt; tasya cādṛṣṭa.śubhāśubha.karamākhya.hetum antareṇābhāvāt /
analyzed: na ca dṛṣṭaḥ eva mātā pitṛ ādikaḥ tasya hetuḥ iti vaktavyam dṛṣṭa hetu sāmye api surūpa etara ādi bhāvena deha ādīnām vaicitrya darśanāt tasya ca adṛṣṭa śubha aśubha karama ākhya hetum antareṇa abhāvāt

original: ñ: ata eva śubha.dehādīnām puṇya.kāryatvam; itareṣām tu pāpa.kāryatvam iti kāryānumānam /
analyzed: atas eva śubha deha ādīnām puṇya kārya tvam itareṣām tu pāpa kārya tvam iti kārya anumānam

original: ñ: sarvajñavacanaprāmāṇyād vā puṇyapāpayor ubhayoḥ sattā pratipattavyā / viśeṣārthinā tu viśeṣāvaśyaka.ṭīkāvalokanīyā.iti /
analyzed: sarvajña vacana prāmāṇyāt vā puṇya pāpayoḥ ubhayoḥ sattā pratipattavyā viśeṣa arthinā tu viśeṣa āvaśyaka ṭīkā avalokanīyā iti

original: ñ221: athāsravam āha 'mithyātvādyās tu hetavah' ityādi / asad.deva.guru.dharmeṣu sad.devādi.buddhi.mithyātvam /
analyzed: atha āsravam āha mithyātva ādyāḥ tu ityādi asat deva guru dharmeṣu sat deva ādi buddhi mithyātvam

original: ñ: himsā.ādy.anivṛttir aviratiḥ / pramādo madyaviṣayādiḥ / kaṣāyāḥ krodhādayaḥ / yogā mano.vāk.kāyavyāpārāḥ / atraivam akṣara.ghaṭanā /
analyzed: himsā ādi anivṛttiḥ aviratiḥ pramādaḥ madya viṣaya ādiḥ kaṣāyāḥ krodha ādayaḥ yogāḥ manaḥ vāc kāya vyāpārāḥ atra evam akṣara ghaṭanā

original: ñ: mithyātvāviratyādikāḥ punar bandhasya jñānāvaraṇīyādi.karma.bandhasya he hetavah; sa āsravo jina.śāsane vijñeyaḥ /
analyzed: mithyātva avirati ādikāḥ punar bandhasya jñāna āvaraṇīya ādi karma bandhasya he hetavah saḥ āsravaḥ jina śāsane vijñeyaḥ

original: ñ: āsravanti karma ebhyaḥ sa āsravaḥ / tato mithyā.ādi.viṣayā mano.vāk.kāyavyāpārā eva śubhāśubha.karma.bandha.hetutvād āsrava ity arthaḥ /
analyzed: āsravanti karma ebhyaḥ saḥ āsravaḥ tatas mithyā ādi viṣayāḥ manaḥ vāc kāya vyāpārāḥ eva śubha aśubha karma bandha hetu tvāt āsravaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ñ222: atha bandhābhāve katham āsravasyopapattih; āsravāt prāg.bandhasadbhāve vā na tasya bandha.hetutā; prāg.api bandhasya sadbhāvāt / na hi yad yad.hetukam tat tad.abhāve.api bhavati, atiprasaGgāt /
analyzed: atha bandha abhāve katham āsravasya upapattiḥ āsravāt prāk bandha sadbhāve vā na tasya bandha hetu tā prāk api bandhasya sadbhāvāt na hi yat yad hetukam tat tad abhāve api bhavati atiprasaGgāt

original: ñ223: asad etat; yata āsravasya pūrva.bandhāpekṣayā kāryatvam iṣyate; uttara.bandhāpekṣayā ca kāraṇatvam /
analyzed: asat etat yatas āsravasya pūrva bandha apekṣayā kārya tvam iṣyate uttara bandha apekṣayā ca kāraṇa tvam

original: ñ: evam bandhasyāpi pūrvottarāsravāpekṣayā kāryatvam kāraṇatvam ca jñātavyam; bījāGkurayor iva bandhāsravayor anyonyam kārya.kāraṇa.bhāvaniyamāt /
analyzed: evam bandhasya api pūrva uttara āsrava apekṣayā kārya tvam kāraṇa tvam ca jñātavyam bīja ākurayoḥ iva bandha āsravayoḥ anyonyam kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyamāt

original: ñ224: na caivam itaretarāśraya.doṣah; pravāhāpekṣayānāditvāt /
analyzed: na ca evam itaretara āśraya doṣaḥ pravāha apekṣayā anādi tvāt

original: ñ225: ayam cāsravaḥ puṇyāpuṇya.bandha.hetutayā dvividhaḥ / dvividho 'py ayam mithyātvādy.uttara.bhedāpekṣayā.utkarṣāpakarṣa.bhedāpekṣayā vānekaprakāraḥ /
analyzed: ayam ca āsravaḥ puṇya apuṇya bandha hetutayā dvividhaḥ dvividhaḥ pi ayam mithyātva ādi uttara bheda apekṣayā a utkarṣa apakarṣa bheda apekṣayā vā aneka prakāraḥ

original: ñ226: asya ca śubhāśubhamano.vāk.kāyavyāpārarūpasyāsravasya siddhiḥ svātmani svasamvedanādy.adhyakṣatah; parasmimś ca vāk.kāyavyāpārasya kasyacit pratyakṣatah; śeṣasya ca tat.kāryaprabhavānumānataś cāvaseyā; āgamāc ca ///60//
analyzed: asya ca śubha aśubha manaḥ vāc kāya vyāpāra rūpasya āsravasya siddhiḥ sva ātmani sva samvedana ādi adhyakṣataḥ parasmin ca vāc kāya vyāpārasya kasyacid pratyakṣataḥ śeṣasya ca tad kārya prabhava anumānataḥ ca avaseyā āgamāt ca

original: ñ227: atha samvara.bandhau vivṛṇoti /
analyzed: atha samvarabandhau vivṛṇoti

original: ñ: samvaras tan.nirodhas tu bandho jīvasya karmaṇaḥ /
analyzed: samvaraḥ tad nirodhaḥ tu bandhaḥ jīvasya karmaṇaḥ

original: ñ: anyonyānugamātmā tu yaḥ sambandho dvayor api //51//
analyzed: anyonya anugama ātmā tu yaḥ sambandhaḥ dvayoḥ api

original: ñ228: vyākhyā -- teṣām mithyātvāvirati.pramāda.kaṣāya.yogānām samyag.darśanavirati.pramādaparihāra.kṣamā.vigupti.traya.dharmānuprekṣābhir nirodho nivāraṇam sthaganam samvarah; paryāya.kathanena vyākhyā / ātmanaḥ karmopādāna.hetu.bhūtapariṇāmābhāvaḥ samvara ity abhiprāyaḥ /
analyzed: vyākhyā teṣām mithyātva avirati pramāda kaṣāya yogānām samyak darśana virati pramāda parihāra kṣamā vigupti traya dharma anuprekṣābhiḥ nirodhaḥ nivāraṇam sthaganam samvaraḥ paryāya kathanena vyākhyā ātmanaḥ karma upādāna hetu bhūta pariṇāma abhāvaḥ samvaraḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: ñ229: atha bandha.tattvam āha -- 'bandho jīvasya karmaṇah' ityādi / tatra bandhanam bandhah; parasparāśleṣo jīvapradeśapudgalānām kṣīranīravat; athavā badhyate yenātmā pāratantryam āpadyate jñānāvaraṇādinā sa bandhaḥ pudgalapariṇāmaḥ /
analyzed: atha bandha tattvam āha bandhaḥ jīvasya karmaṇaḥ ityādi tatra bandhanam bandhaḥ paraspara āśleṣaḥ jīva pradeśa pudgalānām kṣīra nīra vat athavā badhyate yena ātmā pāratantryam āpadyate jñāna āvaraṇa ādinā sa bandhaḥ pudgala pariṇāmaḥ

original: ñ231: nanu jīva.karmaṇoḥ sambandhaḥ kim goṣṭhāmāhilaparikalpit.kañcukasamyoga.kalpa utānyaḥ kaścid ity āśaGkyāha 'dvayor api' karmavargaṇā.yogyaskandhānām jīvasya cānyonyānugamāatmānyonyānugati.svarūpaḥ parasparānupraveśarūpa ity arthaḥ /
analyzed: nanu jīva karmaṇoḥ sambandhaḥ kim goṣṭha amāhila parikalpit kañcuka samyoga kalpaḥ uta anyaḥ kaścid iti āśaGkya āha dvayoḥ api karma vargaṇā yogya skandhānām jīvasya ca anyonya anugama āatma anyonya anugati svarūpaḥ paraspara anupraveśa rūpaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ñ: ayam atra bhāvaḥ -- vahny.ayas.piṇḍasambandhavat kṣīrodakasamparkavad vā jīva.karmaṇor mitho 'nupraveśātmaka eva sambandho bandho boddhavyah; na punaḥ kañcuki.kañcukasamyoga.kalpo 'nyo vā.iti /
analyzed: ayam atra bhāvaḥ vahni ayaḥ piṇḍa sambandha vat kṣīra udaka samparka vat vā jīva karmaṇoḥ mithas nupraveśa ātmakaḥ eva sambandhaḥ bandhaḥ boddhavyaḥ na punar kañcuki kañcuka samyoga kalpaḥ vā iti

original: ñ232: atrāha -- katham amūrtasya ātmano hastādy.asambhave saty ādāna.śakti.virahāt karma.grahaṇam ucyata iti cet /

original: ñ233: ucyate; iyam eva tāvad asthānārekā prakriyā bhavato 'nabhijñatām jñāpayati; yataḥ kenāmūrtatābhyupetā.ātmanaḥ /
analyzed: ucyate iyam eva tāvat prakriyā bhavataḥ jñāpayati yatas kena amūrta tā abhyupetā ātmanaḥ

original: ñ: karma.jīvasambandhasyānāditvād ekatvapariṇāme sati kṣīrodakavan mūrta eva karma.grahaṇe vyāpriyate; na ca hastādi.vyāpārādeyam karma; kim.tu paudgalam api sad.adhyavasāyaviśeṣād rāga.dveṣamohapariṇāmābhyañjana.lakṣaṇād ātmanaḥ karma.yogyapudgala.jāla.śleṣaṇam ādānam snehābhyaktavapuṣo rajo.laganavad iti /
analyzed: karma jīva sambandhasya anādi tvāt ekatva pariṇāme sati kṣīrodaka vat mūrtaḥ eva karma grahaṇe vyāpriyate na ca hasta ādi vyāpāra ādeyam karma kim tu paudgalam api sa dadhyavasāya viśeṣāt rāga dveṣa moha pariṇāma abhyañjana lakṣaṇāt ātmanaḥ karma yogya pudgala jāla śleṣaṇam ādānam sneha abhyakta vapuṣaḥ rajaḥ lagana vat iti

original: ñ: pratipradeśānantaparamāṇu.samśleṣāj jīvasya karmaṇā saha lolī.bhāvāt kathamcin mūrtatvam api samsārāvasthāyām abhyupagamyata eva syād vādavādibhir iti /
analyzed: prati pradeśa ananta paramāṇu samśleṣāt jīvasya karmaṇā saha lolībhāvāt kathamcid mūrta tvam api samsāra avasthāyām abhyupagamyate eva syāt vāda vādibhiḥ iti

original: ñ234: sa ca praśastāpraśasta.bhedād dvedhā / prakṛti.sthity.anubhāgapradeśa.bhedāc ca caturdhā / prakṛtiḥ svabhāvo yathā jñānāvaraṇam jñānācchādanasvabhāvam ityādi /
analyzed: sa ca praśasta apraśasta bhedāt dvedhā prakṛti sthiti anubhāga pradeśa bhedāt ca caturdhā prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ yathā jñāna āvaraṇam jñāna ācchādana svabhāvam ityādi

original: ñ: sthitir adhyavasāya.kṛtaḥ kālavibhāgah; anubhāgo rasah; pradeśaḥ karma.dalasamcaya iti / punar api mūlaprakṛti.bhedād aṣṭadhā jñānāvaraṇādikaḥ /
analyzed: sthitiḥ adhyavasāya kṛtaḥ kāla vibhāgaḥ anubhāgaḥ rasaḥ pradeśaḥ karma dala samcayaḥ iti punar api mūlaprakṛti bhedāt aṣṭadhā jñāna āvaraṇa ādikaḥ

original: ñ: uttaraprkṛti.bhedād aṣṭapañcāśad.adhika.śata.bhedaḥ / so 'pi tīvra.tīvrataramandamandatarādi.bhedād anekavidha ityādi karma.granthād avaseyam / uktam bandha.tattvam /
analyzed: uttara prkṛti bhedāt aṣṭapañcāśat adhika śata bhedaḥ saḥ pi tīvra tīvratara manda mandatara ādi bhedāt anekavidhaḥ ityādi karma granthāt avaseyam uktam bandha tattvam

original: ñ235: nirjarā.tattvam āha --
analyzed: nirjarā tattvam āha

analyzed: baddhasya karmaṇaḥ sa aṭaḥ yaḥ tu sā nirjarā matā

original: ñ: ātyantiko viyogas tu dehāder mokṣa ucyate //52//

original: ñ236: vyākhyā -- yas tu baddhasya jīvena sambaddhasya karmaṇo jñānāvaraṇādeḥ sāṭaḥ saṭanam dvādaśavidhena tapasā vicaṭanam sā nirjarā matā sammatā /

original: ñ: dvitīyapakṣe sa ātmā prakṛtyātmanoḥ samyoge hetutvam pratipadyamānaḥ kim svayam prakṛti.saha.kṛtaḥ san hetur bhavati tad.viyukto vā /
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣe saḥ ātmā prakṛti ātmanoḥ samyoge hetu tvam pratipadyamānaḥ kim svayam prakṛti sahakṛtaḥ san hetuḥ bhavati tad viyuktaḥ vā

original: ñ: ādye tasyāpi prakṛti.samyogaḥ katham ity anavasthā /

original: ñ: dvitīye punaḥ sa prakṛti.rahita ātmā śuddha.caitanyasvarūpaḥ san kim.artham prakṛtyā.ātmanoḥ samyoge hetutvam pratipadyate /

original: ñ: tatra ko 'pi hetur vilokya iti tad evāvartata ity anavasthā / iti sahetukaḥ prakṛtyātmasamyogo nirastaḥ / atha nirhetukah; tarhi muktātmano 'pi prakṛti.samyogaprasaGgaḥ /

original: ñ256: kim ca; ayam ātmā prakṛtim upādadānaḥ pūrvāvasthām jahyān na vā / ādye.anityatvāpattiḥ / dvitīye tad.upādānam eva durghaṭam /

original: ñ257: kim ca; yad uktam 'viveka.khyāteh' ityādi; tad avicāritaramaṇīyam / tatra kā.iyam khyātir nāma prakṛti.puruṣayoḥ svena svena rūpeṇāvasthitayor bhedena pratibhāsanam iti cet; sā kasya - prakṛteḥ puruṣasya vā / na prakṛteh; tasyā asamvedyaparvaṇi sthitatvād acetanatvād anabhyupagamāc ca / nāpy ātmanah; tasyāpy asamvedyaparvaṇi sthitatvāt /
analyzed: kim ca yat uktam ityādi tat avicārita ramaṇīyam tatra kāiyam khyātiḥ nāma prakṛti puruṣayoḥ svena svena rūpeṇa avasthitayoḥ bhedena pratibhāsanam iti ced sā kasya prakṛteḥ puruṣasya vā na prakṛtā ih tasyāḥ asamvedya parvaṇi sthita tvāt acetana tvāt anabhyupagamāt ca nā api ātmanaḥ tasya api asamvedya parvaṇi sthita tvāt

original: ñ: tadā tad.asattve vā prakṛter nityaikarūpatā.hānih; pūrvasvabhāva.tyāgenottarasvabhāvopādānasya nityaikarūpatāyām virodhāt; pariṇāmini nitya eva tad.avirodhāt /

original: ñ: prakṛteś ca pariṇāminityatvābhyupagama ātmano 'pi tad aGgī.kartavyam tasyāpi prāktanasukhopabhoktṛ.svabhāvaparihāreṇa mokṣe tad.abhoktṛ.svabhāvasvīkārāt; amuktādi.svabhāva.tyāgena muktatvādi.svabhāvopādānāc ca /

original: ñ: samtānasyocchedārtho 'nutpādārtho vā tat.prayāsa ity apy anena nirastam; kṣaṇocchedānutpādavat / tayor apy abhāvarūpatayā nirhetukatvāt kuto 'py utpatty.anupapatteḥ /
analyzed: samtānasya uccheda arthaḥ n utpāda arthaḥ vā tad prayāsaḥ iti api anena nirastam kṣaṇa uccheda anutpāda vat tayoḥ api abhāva rūpa tayā nirhetuka tvāt kutas pi utpatti anupapatteḥ

original: ñ: kim ca; vāstavasya samtānasya anabhyupagamāt kim tad.ucchedādi.prayāsena / na hi mṛtasya māraṇam kvāpi dṛṣṭam; tan na samtānoccheda.lakṣaṇā muktir ghaṭate /
analyzed: kim ca vāstavasya samtānasya anabhyupagamāt kim tad uccheda ādi prayāsena na hi mṛtasya māraṇam kvāpi dṛṣṭam tat na samtāna uccheda lakṣaṇā muktiḥ ghaṭate

original: ñ268: atha 'nirāśraya(āsrava).cittasamtaty.utpatti.lakṣaṇā sā tat.prayāsasādhyā.iti pakṣas tu jyāyan / kevalam sā cittasantatiḥ sānvayā niranvayā vā.iti vaktavyam /
analyzed: atha nirāśraya āsrava citta samtati utpatti lakṣaṇā sā tad prayāsa sādhyā iti pakṣaḥ tu jyāyan kevalam sā citta santatiḥ sa anvayā niranvayā vā iti vaktavyam

original: ñ: ādye siddhasādhanam; tathā.bhūta eva cittasamtāne mokṣopapatteh; baddho hi mucyate nābaddhaḥ / dvitīyo 'nupapannah; niranvaye hi samtāne.anyo badhyate.anyaś ca mucyate; tathā ca baddhsya mukty.artham pravṛttir na syāt; kṛtanāśādayaś ca doṣāḥ pṛṣṭa.lagnā eva dhāvanti / (ṣuali pṛṣṭi.lagnāh) (Hindi isa 'pakṣake pīcche hī pīcche cale āyemge')
analyzed: ādye siddhasādhanam tathābhūte eva citta samtāne mokṣa upapatteḥ baddhaḥ hi mucyate na ābaddhaḥ dvitīyaḥ niranvaye hi samtāne anyaḥ badhyate anyaḥ ca mucyate tathā ca baddhsya mukti artham pravṛttiḥ na syāt kṛta nāśa ādayaḥ ca doṣāḥ pṛṣṭa lagnāḥ eva dhāvanti pṛṣṭi lagnāḥ

original: ñ269: tathā yad uktam 'kāya.kleśa' ityādi; tad apy asatyam; himsā.virati.rūpavratopabṛmhakasya kāya.kleśasya karmaphalatve.api tapastvavirodhāt; vratāvirodhī hi kāya.kleśaḥ karmanirjarā.hetutvāt tapo 'bhidhīyate /
analyzed: tathā yat uktam kāya kleśaḥ ityādi tat api asatyam himsā virati rūpa vrata upabṛmhakasya kāya kleśasya karma phala tve api tapaḥ tva virodhāt vrata avirodhī hi kāya kleśaḥ karma nirjarā hetu tvāt tapaḥ bhidhīyate

original: ñ: na caivam nārakādi.kāya.kleśasya tapastvaprasaGgah; tasya himsā.ādyāveśapradhānatayā tapastvavirodhāt; ataḥ katham prekṣāvatām tena samānatā sādhu.kāya.kleśasyāpādayitum śakyā /
analyzed: na ca evam nāraka ādi kāya kleśasya tapaḥ tva prasaGgāt tasya himsā ādi āveśa pradhāna tayā tapaḥ tva virodhāt atas katham prekṣāvatām tena samāna tā sādhu kāya kleśasya āpādayitum śakyā

original: ñ290: tad api śakti.samkarapakṣe 'svalpena' ityādi proktam tat su.uktam eva; vicitraphala.dānasamarthānām karmaṇām śakti.samkare sati kṣīṇamohāntyasamaye cākleśataḥ svalpenaiva śukla.dhyānena tapasā prakṣayābhyupagamāt; jīvan.mukteḥ paramamukteś cānyathānupapatteḥ /
analyzed: tat api śakti samkara pakṣe su alpena ityādi proktam tat su uktam eva vicitra phala dāna samarthānām karmaṇām śakti samkare sati kṣīṇa moha antya samaye ca akleśataḥ su alpena eva śukla dhyānena tapasā prakṣaya abhyupagamāt jīvanmukteḥ parama mukteḥ ca anyathā anupapatteḥ

original: ñ: sa tu tat.śakti.samkaro bahutara.kāya.kleśasādhya iti yuktas tad.artho 'nekopavāsādi.kāya.kleśādy.anuṣṭhānaprayāsah; tam antareṇa tat.samkarānupapatteh;
analyzed: sa tu tad śakti samkaraḥ bahutara kāya kleśa sādhyaḥ iti yuktaḥ tad arthaḥ neka upavāsa ādi kāya kleśa ādi anuṣṭhāna prayāsaḥ tam antareṇa tad samkara anupapattā iha

original: ñ: tataḥ kathamcid anavacchinno jñānasamtāno 'nekavidha.tapo 'nuṣṭhānān mucyate; tasya cānanta.catuṣṭaya.lābhasvarūpo mokṣa iti pratipattavyam /
analyzed: tatas kathamcid anavacchinnaḥ jñāna samtānaḥ nekavidha tapaḥ nuṣṭhānāt mucyate tasya ca ananta catuṣṭaya lābha svarūpaḥ mokṣaḥ iti pratipattavyam

original: ñ271: athātra digambarāḥ sva.yuktīḥ sphorayanti / nanu bhavatu yathā.ukta.lakṣaṇo mokṣah; param sa puruṣasyaiva ghaṭate na tv aGganāyāh; tathā hi -- na striyo mokṣa.bhājanam bhavanti; puruṣebhyo hinatvāt; napumsakavat /
analyzed: atha atra digambarāḥ sva yuktīḥ sphorayanti nanu bhavatu yathā ukta lakṣaṇaḥ mokṣaḥ param sa puruṣasya eva ghaṭate na tu tathā hi na striyaḥ mokṣa bhājanam bhavanti puruṣebhyaḥ napumsaka vat

original: ñ272: atrocyate -- strīṇām puruṣebhyo hīnatvam kim cāaritrādy.abhāvena, viśiṣṭasāmarthyāsattvena; puruṣānabhivandyatvena, smāraṇādy.akartṛtvena (kṣāraṇādy-); amaharṛddhikatvena; māyā.ādi.prakarṣavattvena vā /
analyzed: atra ucyate strīṇām puruṣebhyaḥ hīna tvam kim ca aaritra ādi abhāvena viśiṣṭa sāmarthya asattvena puruṣa an abhivandya tvena smāraṇa ādi akartṛ tvena kṣāraṇa ādi a maharṛddhika tvena māyā ādi prakarṣavat tvena vā

original: ñ: tatr na tāvad ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ kṣoda.kṣamah; yataḥ kim cāritrābhāvaḥ sacelatvena; mandasattvatayā vā / tatra yady ādyapakṣaḥ tadā celasyāpi cāritrābhāva.hetutuvam kim paibhogamātreṇa parigraharūpatayā vā /
analyzed: tatra na tāvat ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ yatas kim cāritra abhāvaḥ sa cela tvena manda sattva tayā vā tatra yadi ādya pakṣaḥ tadā celasya api kim paibhoga mātreṇa parigraha rūpatayā vā

original: ñ: yadi paribhogamātreṇa; tadā paribhogo 'pi kim vastraparityāgāsamarthatvena samyamopakāritvena vā / tatra na tāvad ādyah; yataḥ prāṇebhyo 'pi nāparam priyam; prāṇān apy etāḥ parityajantyo dṛśyante; vastrasya kā kathā /
analyzed: yadi paribhoga mātreṇa tadā kim vastra parityāga asamartha tvena samyama upakāri tvena vā tatra na tāvat ādyaḥ yatas prāṇebhyaḥ na aparam priyam prāṇān api etāḥ parityajantyaḥ dṛśyante vastrasya kā kathā

original: ñ: atha samyamopakāritvena; tarhi kim na puruṣāṇām api samyamopakāritayā vastraparibhogaḥ /
analyzed: atha samyama upakāri tvena tarhi kim na puruṣāṇām api samyama upakāri tayā vastra paribhogaḥ

original: ñ273: athābalā etā balād api puruṣair upabhujyanta iti tadvinā tāsām samyama.bādhā.sambhavo na punar narāṇām iti na teṣām tad.upabhoga iti cet / (check)
analyzed: atha abalāḥ etāḥ balāt api puruṣaiḥ upabhujyante iti tat vinā tāsām samyak abādhā sambhavaḥ na punar narāṇām iti na teṣām tad upabhogaḥ iti ced

original: ñ274: tarhi na vastrāc cāritrābhāvah; tad.upakāritvāt tasya; āhārādivat / nāpi paigraharūpatayā; yato 'sya tad.rūpatā kim mūrcchā.hetutvena; dhāraṇamātreṇa vā; athavā sparśamātreṇa jīvasamsakti.hetutvena vā /
analyzed: tarhi na vastrāt tad upakāri tvāt tasya āhāra ādi vat na api paigraha rūpatayā yatas tad rūpatā kim mūrcchā hetu tvena dhāraṇa mātreṇa vā athavā sparśa mātreṇa jīva samsakti hetu tvena vā

original: ñ: tatra yady ādyah; tarhi śarīram api mūrcchāyā hetur na vā / tāvad ahetuh; tasyāntar.aGga.tattvena durlabhataratayā viśeṣatas tadd.hetutvāt /
analyzed: tatra yadi ādyaḥ tarhi śarīram api mūrcchāyāḥ hetuḥ na vā tāvat ahetuḥ tasya antara ga tattvena durlabhatara tayā viśeṣataḥ tad hetu tvāt

original: ñ: atha murcchāyā hetur iti pakṣah; tarhi vastravat tasyāpi kim dustyajatvena; mukty.aGgatayā vā na prathama eva parihāraḥ /
analyzed: atha murcchāyāḥ hetuḥ iti tarhi vastra vat tasya api kim dustyaja tvena mukti aGga tayā vā na prathamaḥ eva parihāraḥ

original: ñ: yadi dustyajatvena.iti pakṣah; tadā tad api kim sarvapuruṣāṇām keṣāmcid vā / na tāvat sarveṣām; dṛśyante hi bahavo vahni.praveśādibhiḥ śarīram api tyajantaḥ /
analyzed: yadi dustyaja tvena eti tadā tat api kim sarva puruṣāṇām keṣāmcid vā na tāvat sarveṣām dṛśyante hi bahavaḥ vahni praveśa ādibhiḥ śarīram api tyajantaḥ

original: ñ: atha keṣāmcit; tadā vastram api keṣāmcid dustyajam iti na parihāryam śarīravat / atha mukty.aGgatvena.iti pakṣah; tarhi vastrasyāpi tathā.vidha.śakti.vikalānām svādhyāyādy.upaṣṭambhakatvena -- śarīravan mukty.aGgatvat kim iti parihāraḥ /
analyzed: atha keṣāmcid tadā vastram api keṣāmcid dustyajam iti na parihāryam śarīra vat atha mukti aGga tvena eti tarhi vastrasya api tathāvidha śakti vikalānām svādhyāya ādi upaṣṭambhaka tvena śarīra vat mukti aGga tvat kim iti parihāraḥ

original: ñ: atha dhāraṇāmātreṇa; evam sati śīta.kāle pratimā.āpannam sādhum dṛṣṭvā kenāpy aviṣahyopanipātam adya śītam iti vibhāvya dharmārthinā sādhu.śirasi vastre prakṣipte saparigrahatā syāt /
analyzed: atha dhāraṇā mātreṇa evam sati śīta kāle pratimā āpannam sādhum dṛṣṭvā kena api a viṣahya upanipātam adya śītam iti vibhāvya dharma arthinā sādhu śirasi vastre prakṣipte sa parigraha tā syāt

original: ñ: atha yadi sparśamātreṇa; tadā bhūmyādinā nirantaram sparśasadbhāvāt saparigrahatvena tīrtha.karādīnām api na mokṣaḥ syād iti lābham icchato bhavato mūla.kṣatiḥ samjātā /
analyzed: atha yadi sparśa mātreṇa tadā bhūmi ādinā nirantaram sparśa sadbhāvāt sa parigraha tvena tīrthakara ādīnām api na mokṣaḥ syāt iti lābham icchataḥ bhavataḥ mūla kṣatiḥ samjātā

original: ñ: atha jīvasamsakti.hetutvena; tarhi śarīrasyāpi jīvasamsakti.hetutvāt parigrahaitutvam astu; kṛmi.maṇḍūkādy.utpādasya tatra pratiprāṇi.pratītatvād /
analyzed: atha jīva samsakti hetu tvena tarhi śarīrasya api jīva samsakti hetu tvāt parigraha aitu tvam astu kṛmi maṇḍūka ādi utpādasya tatra prati prāṇi pratīta tvāt

original: ñ: athāsti; param yatanā tatra vidhīyate; tenāyam adoṣa iti cet; tarhi.vastre.apy ayam nyāyaḥ kim kākair bhakṣitaḥ /
analyzed: atha asti param yatanā tatra vidhīyate tena ayam adoṣaḥ iti ced ayam nyāyaḥ kim kākaiḥ bhakṣitaḥ

original: ñ: vastrasyāpi yatanayā.eva sīvana.kṣālanādi.karaṇena jīvasamsaktinivāraṇāt / tan na vastrasadbhāvena cāritrāsambhavaḥ /
analyzed: vastrasya api sīvana kṣālana ādi karaṇena jīva samsakti nivāraṇāt tat na vastra sadbhāvena cāritra asambhavaḥ

original: ñ275: nāpi mandasattvatayā; yataḥ sattvam iha vrata.tapo.dhāraṇaviṣayam eṣitavyam; tac ca tāsv analpam sudurdhara.śīlavatīṣu sambhavati / ato na cāritrāsambhavena tāsām hīnatvam /
analyzed: nā api manda sattva tayā yatas sattvam iha vrata tapaḥ dhāraṇa viṣayam eṣitavyam tat ca tāsu analpam su durdhara śīlavatīṣu sambhavati atas na cāritra asambhavena tāsām hīna tvam

original: ñ: nanu bhavatv aviśiṣṭam cāritram strīṇām; param paramaprakarṣaprāptam yathā.ākhyātābhidham tāsām na syād iti puruṣebhyo hīnatvam iti cet /
analyzed: nanu bhavatu aviśiṣṭam cāritram strīṇām param parama prakarṣa prāptam yathā ākhyāta abhidham tāsām na syāt iti puruṣebhyaḥ hīna tvam iti ced

original: ñ: tarhi cāritraparamaprakarṣābhāvo 'pi tāsām kim kāraṇābhāvena; virodhasambhavena ca /
analyzed: tarhi tāsām kim kāraṇa abhāvena virodha sambhavena ca

original: ñ: na tāvad ādyaḥ pakṣah; aviśiṣṭa.cāritrābhyāsasyaiva tan.nibandhanatvāt; tasya ca strīṣv anantaram eva samarthitatvāt /
analyzed: na tāvat ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ a viśiṣṭa cāritra abhyāsasya eva tad nibandhana tvāt tasya ca strīṣu anantaram eva samarthita tvāt

original: ñ: nāpi dvitīyah; yathā.ākhyāta.cāritrasyārvāg.dṛśām atyantaparokṣatayā kenacid virodhānirṇayād iti na cāritrābhāvena strīṇām hīnatvam /
analyzed: na api dvitīyaḥ yathā ākhyāta cāritrasya arvāk dṛśām atyanta parokṣa tayā kenacid virodha anirṇayāt iti na cāritra abhāvena strīṇām hīna tvam

original: ñ:
analyzed: ñ

original: ñ276: nāpi viśiṣṭasāmarthyāsattvena; yata idam api kim saptamanarakapṛthvī.gamanāyogyatvena; vādādi.labdhi.rahitatvena; alpa.śrutatvena ca /
analyzed: nā api viśiṣṭa sāmarthya asattvena yatas idam api kim saptama naraka pṛthvī gamana ayogya tvena vāda ādi labdhi rahita tvena alpa śruta tvena ca

original: ñ: na tāvad ādyaḥ pakṣah; yatas tad.abhāve kim yatraiva janmani tāsām mukti.gāmitvam tatraivocyate; sāmānyena vā /
analyzed: na tāvat ādyaḥ yatas tad abhāve kim yatra eva janmani tāsām mukti gāmi tvam tatra eva ucyate sāmānyena vā

original: ñ: yatrādyapakṣah; tarhi puruṣāṇām api yatra yanmani mukti.gāmitvam tatra saptamapṛthvī.gamana.yogyatvam; tatas teṣām api mukty.abhāvaḥ syāt /
analyzed: tarhi puruṣāṇām api yatra mukti gāmi tvam tatra saptama pṛthvī gamana yogya tvam tatas teṣām api mukti abhāvaḥ syāt

original: ñ: atha dvitīyah; tadāyam āśayo bhavatah; yathā sarvotkṛṣṭapadaprāptiḥ sarvotkṛṣṭenādhyavasāyena prāpyate; sarvotkṛṣṭe ca dve ca pade sarva.duhkhasthānam saptamī narakapṛthvī sarvasukhasthānam mokṣaś ca; tato yathā strīṇām saptamapṛthvī.gamanam āgme niṣiddham tad.gamana.yogya.tathā.vidhasarvotkṛṣṭamano.vīryābhāvāt;
analyzed: atha dvitīyaḥ tadā ayam āśayaḥ yathā sarva utkṛṣṭa pada prāptiḥ sarva utkṛṣṭena adhyavasāyena prāpyate sarva utkṛṣṭe ca dve ca pade sarva duhkha sthānam saptamī naraka pṛthvī sarva sukha sthānam mokṣaḥ ca tatas yathā strīṇām saptama pṛthvī gamanam niṣiddham tad gamana yogya tathāvidha sarva utkṛṣṭa manaḥ vīrya abhāvāt

original: evam mokṣo 'pi tathā.vidha.śubhamano.vīryābhāvān na strīṇām bhaviṣyati /
analyzed: evam tathāvidha śubha manaḥ vīrya abhāvāt na strīṇām bhaviṣyati

original: ñ: prayogaś cāyam -- nāsti strīṣu mukti.kāraṇa.śubhamano.vīryaparamaprakarṣaḥ prakarṣatvāt saptamapṛthvī.gamana.kāraṇāśubhamano.vīryaparamaprakarṣavat; tad etad ayuktam; vyāpter abhāvāt /
analyzed: ñ prayogaḥ ca ayam na asti strīṣu mukti kāraṇa śubha manaḥ vīrya parama prakarṣaḥ prakarṣa tvāt saptama pṛthvī gamana kāraṇa aśubha manaḥ vīrya parama prakarṣa vat tat etat ayuktam vyāpteḥ abhāvāt

original: ñ: na hi bahir.vyāpti.mātreṇa hetur gamakaḥ syāt; kim tv antar.vyāptyā; anyathā tat.putratvāder api gamakatvarpasaGgah; antar.vyāptiś ca pratibandha.balenaiva sidhyati; na cātra pratibandho vidyate; tataḥ samdigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikam idam sādhanam /
analyzed: na hi bahis vyāpti mātreṇa hetuḥ gamakaḥ syāt kim tu antar vyāptyā anyathā tad putra tva ādeḥ api antar vyāptiḥ ca pratibandha balena eva sidhyati na ca atra pratibandhaḥ vidyate tatas samdigdha vipakṣa vyāvṛttikam idam sādhanam

original: ñ: carama.śarīribhir niścitavyabhicāram ca; teṣām hi saptamapṛthvī.gamana.hetu.mano.vīryaprakarṣābhāve.api mukti.hetu.mano.vīryaprakarṣasadbhāvāt /
analyzed: carama śarīribhiḥ niścita vyabhicāram ca teṣām hi saptama pṛthvī gamana hetu manaḥ vīrya prakarṣa abhāve api mukti hetu manaḥ vīrya prakarṣa sadbhāvāt

original: ñ: tathā matsyair api vyabhicārah; teṣām hi saptamapṛthvī.gamana.hetu.mano.vīryaprakarṣasadbhāve.api na mukti.gamana.hetu.śubhamano.vīryaprakarṣasadbhāva iti /
analyzed: tathā matsyaiḥ api vyabhicāraḥ teṣām hi saptama pṛthvī gamana hetu manaḥ vīrya prakarṣa sadbhāve api na mukti gamana hetu śubha manaḥ vīrya prakarṣa sadbhāve iti

original: ñ: tathā na hi yeṣām adho.gamana.śaktiḥ stokā teṣām ūrdhva.gatāv api śaktiḥ stokā.eva; bhujaparisarpādibhir vyabhicārāt /
analyzed: tathā na hi yeṣām adhas gamana śaktiḥ teṣām ūrdhva gatau api śaktiḥ bhuja parisarpa ādibhiḥ vyabhicārāt

original: ñ: tathā hi -- bhujaparisarpā adho dvitīyām eva pṛthvīm gacchanti na tato adhah; pakṣiṇas tṛtīyām yāvat; caturthī catuṣpadāh; pañcamīm uragāh; atha ca sarve.apy ūrdhvam utkarṣataḥ sahasrāram yāvad gacchanti; ato na saptamapṛthvī.gamanāyogyatvena viśiṣṭasāmarthāsattvam /
analyzed: tathā hi bhuja parisarpāḥ adhas dvitīyām eva pṛthvīm gacchanti na tatas adhas pakṣiṇaḥ tṛtīyām yāvat caturthī catuṣpadāḥ pañcamīm uragāḥ atha ca sarve api ūrdhvam utkarṣataḥ sahasrāram yāvat gacchanti atas na saptama pṛthvī gamana ayogya tvena viśiṣṭa sāmartha asattvam

original: ñ277: nāpi vādādi.labdhi.rahitatvena; mūka.kevalibhir vyabhicārāt /

original: ñ339: tataḥ pratidravya.kṣetrādi.prakāram ghaṭasyāvaktavyatāpi svadharmaḥ syāt; tasya cānantebhyo vaktavyebhyo dharmebhyo 'nya.dravyebhyaś ca vyāvṛttatvenānantā avaktavyāḥ para.dharmā api bhavanti /
analyzed: tatas prati dravya kṣetra ādi prakāram ghaṭasya avaktavya tā api svadharmaḥ syāt tasya ca anantebhyaḥ vaktavyebhyaḥ dharmebhyaḥ nyadravyebhyaḥ ca vyāvṛtta tvena anantāḥ avaktavyāḥ para dharmāḥ api bhavanti

original: ñ340: tad evam ananta.dharmātmakatvam yathā ghaṭe darśitam; tathā sarvasminn apy ātmādike vastuni bhāvanīyam /
analyzed: tat evam ananta dharma ātmaka tvam yathā ghaṭe darśitam tathā sarvasmin api ātma ādike vastuni bhāvanīyam

original: ñ341: tatrāpy ātmani tāvac caitanyam kartṛtvam bhoktṛtvam pramātṛtvam prameyatvam amūrtatvam asamkhyātapradeśatvam niścalāṣṭapradeśatvam lokapramāṇapradeśatvam jīvatvam abhavyatvam bhavyatvam pariṇāmitvam sva.śarīravyāpitvam ityādayaḥ sahabhāvino dharmāh;
analyzed: tatra api ātmani tāvat caitanyam kartṛ tvam bhoktṛ tvam pramātṛ tvam prameya tvam amūrta tvam asamkhyāta pradeśa tvam niścala aṣṭa pradeśa tvam loka pramāṇa pradeśa tvam jīva tvam abhavya tvam bhavya tvam pariṇāmi tvam sva śarīra vyāpi tvam ityādayaḥ sahabhāvinaḥ dharmāḥ ah

original: harṣaviṣādau sukha.duhkhe matyādi.jñāna.cakṣur.darśanopayogau devanāraka.tiryag.naratvāni śarīrāditayā pariṇamitasarvapudgalatvam anādy.anantatvam sarva.jīvaiḥ saha sarvasambandhavattvam samsāritvam krodhādy.asmkhyādhyavasāyavattvam hāsyādi.ṣaṭkam strī.pum.napumsakatvamūrkhatvāndhatvādīni.ityādayaḥ krama.bhāvino dharmāḥ /
analyzed: harṣa viṣādau sukha duhkhe mati ādi jñāna cakṣuḥ darśana upayogau deva nāraka tiryak nara tvāni śarīra ādi tayā pariṇamita sarva pudgala tvam anādi ananta tvam sarva jīvaiḥ saha sarva sambandhavat tvam samsāri tvam hāsya ādi ṣaṭkam strī pum napumsaka tva mūrkha tva andha tva ādīni ityādayaḥ kramabhāvinaḥ dharmāḥ

original: ñ342: muktātmani tu siddhatvam sādy.anantatvam jñāna.darśanasamyaktvasukhavīryāṇy ananta.dravya.kṣetra.kālasarvaparyāya.jñātṛtva.darśitvāny aśarīratvam ajarāmaratvam arūparasa.gandhasparśa.śabdatvāni niścalatvam nīruktvam akṣayatvam avyābādhatvam prāk.samsārāvasthānubhūtasvasva.jīva.dharmāś ca.ityādayaḥ /
analyzed: muktātmani tu siddha tvam sādi ananta tvam jñāna darśana samyaktva sukha vīryāṇi ananta dravya kṣetra kāla sarva paryāya jñātṛ tva darśi tvāni aśarīra tvam ajara amara tvam arūpa rasa gandha sparśa śabda tvāni niścala tvam nīruj tvam akṣaya tvam avyābādha tvam prāk samsāra avasthā anubhūta sva sva jīva dharmāḥ caitya ādayaḥ

original: ñ343: dharmādharmākāśa.kāleṣv asamkhyātāsamkhyātānantapradeśāpradetvam (ñain anantapradeśāpradeśatvam) sarva.jīvapudgalānām gati.sthity.avagāhavartanā.upagrāhakatvam tat.tad.avacchedakāvacchedyatvam avasthitatvam anādy.anantatvam arūpitvam arugu.laghutā.ekaskandatvam matyādi.jñnānaviṣayatvam sattvam dravyatvam ityādayaḥ /
analyzed: dharma adharma ākāśa kāleṣu asamkhyāta asamkhyāta ananta pradeśa apradetvam ananta pradeśa apradetvam sarva jīva pudgalānām gati sthiti avagāha vartanā upagrāhaka tvam tad tad avacchedaka avacchedya tvam avasthita tvam anādi ananta tvam arūpi tvam mati ādi jñnāna viṣaya tvam sattvam dravya tvam ityādayaḥ

original: ñ344: paudgalika.dravyeṣu ghaṭa.dṛṣṭāntoktarītyā svaparaparyāyāḥ / śabdeṣu codāttānudāttasvaritavivṛtasamvṛta.ghoṣavad.aghoṣatālpaprāṇamahā.prāṇatābhilāpyānabhilāpyārthavācakāvācakatā.kṣetra.kālādi.bheda.hetuka.tat.tad.anantārthapratyāyana.śaktyādayaḥ /
analyzed: paudgalika dravyeṣu ghaṭa dṛṣṭānta ukta rītyā sva para paryāyāḥ śabdeṣu ca udātta anudātta svarita vivṛta samvṛta ghoṣavat aghoṣa tā alpa prāṇa mahāprāṇa tā abhilāpya anabhilāpya artha vācaka avācaka tā kṣetra kāla ādi bheda hetuka tad tad ananta artha pratyāyana śakti ādayaḥ

original: ñ345: ātmādiṣu ca sarveṣu nityānityasāmānyaviśeṣasad.asad.abhilāpyānabhilāpyatvātmakatā parebhyaś ca vastubhyo vyāvṛtti.dharmāś cāvaseyāḥ / (Hindi kahe jāne lāyaka padārthakā kathana karanā)
analyzed: ātma ādiṣu ca sarveṣu nitya anitya sāmānya viśeṣa sat asat abhilāpya anabhilāpya tva ātmaka tā parebhyaḥ ca vastubhyaḥ vyāvṛtti dharmāḥ ca avaseyāḥ

original: ñ346: āha -- svaparyāyās te tasya sambandhino bhavantu; ye tu paraparyāyās te vibhinnavastv.āśrayatvāt katham tasya sambandho vyapadiśyante /
analyzed: āha sva paryāyāḥ te tasya sambandhinaḥ bhavantu ye tu para paryāyāḥ te vibhinna vastu āśraya tvāt katham tasya sambandhaḥ vyapadiśyante

original: ñ347: ucyate; iha dvidhā sambandho 'stitvena nāstitvena ca / tatra svaparyāyair astitvena sambandhaḥ yathā ghaṭasya rūpādibhiḥ /
analyzed: ucyate iha dvidhā sambandhaḥ u stitvena nāstitvena ca tatra sva paryāyaiḥ astitvena sambandhaḥ yathā ghaṭasya rūpa ādibhiḥ

original: ñ: paraparyāyais tu nāstitvena sambandhas teṣām tatrāsambhavāt; yathā ghaṭāvasthāyām mṛd.rūpatā.paryāyeṇa; yata eva ca te tasya na santi.iti nāstitvasambandhena sambaddhāh; ata eva ca te paraparyāyā iti vyapadiśyante /
analyzed: para paryāyaiḥ tu nāstitvena sambandhaḥ teṣām tatra asambhavāt yathā ghaṭa avasthāyām mṛd rūpa tā paryāyeṇa yatas eva ca te tasya na santi iti nāstitva sambandhena atas eva ca te para paryāyāḥ iti vyapadiśyante

original: ñ348: nanu ye yatra na vidyante te katham tasya.iti vyapadiśyante; na khalu ghanam daridrasya na vidyata iti tat tasya sambandhi vyapadeṣṭum śakyam; mā prāpal (aor.) lokavyavahārātikramah; --
analyzed: nanu ye yatra na vidyante te katham tasya eti vyapadiśyante na khalu ghanam daridrasya na vidyate iti tat tasya sambandhi vyapadeṣṭum śakyam mā prāpat lokavyavahāra atikramaḥ

original: ñ: na khalu dhanam daridrasya na vidyata iti tat tasya sambandhi vyapadeṣṭum śakyam; mā prāpal lokavyavahārātikramah; tad etan mahāmohamūḍhamanaskatā.sūcakam; --
analyzed: na khalu dhanam daridrasya na vidyate iti tat tasya sambandhi vyapadeṣṭum śakyam mā prāpat lokavyavahāra atikramaḥ tat etat mahā moha mūḍha manaska tā sūcakam

original: ñ: yato yadi nāma te nāstitvasambandham adhikṛtya tasya.iti na vyapadiśyante; tarhi sāmānyatas te paravastuṣv api na santi.iti prāptam; --
analyzed: yatas yadi nāma te nāstitva sambandham adhikṛtya tasya eti na vyapadiśyante tarhi sāmānyatas te para vastuṣu api na santi iti prāptam

original: ñ: tathā ca te svarūpeṇāpi na bhaveyur na caitad dṛṣṭam iṣṭam vā; tasmād avaśyam te nāstitvasambandham adhikṛtya tasya.iti vyapadeśyāh; --
analyzed: tathā ca te sva rūpeṇa api na bhaveyuḥ na ca etat dṛṣṭam iṣṭam vā tasmāt avaśyam te nāstitva sambandham adhikṛtya tasya eti vyapadeśyā āh

original: ñ: dhanam api ca nāstitvasambandham adhikṛtya daridrasya.iti vyapadiśyata eva; tathā loke vaktāro bhavanti 'dhanam asya daridrasya na vidyate' iti /
analyzed: dhanam api ca nāstitva sambandham adhikṛtya daridrasya eti vyapadiśyate eva tathā loke vaktāraḥ bhavanti dhanam asya daridrasya na vidyate iti

original: ñ: yad api coktam 'tat tasya.iti vyapadeṣṭum na śakyam' iti; tatrāpi tad.astitvena tasya.iti vyapadeṣṭum na śakyam; na punar nāstitvenāpi; tato na kaścil lokavyavahārātikramaḥ /
analyzed: yat api ca uktam tat tasya eti vyapadeṣṭum na śakyam iti tatra api tad astitvena tasya eti vyapadeṣṭum na śakyam na punar na astitvena api tatas na kaścid lokavyavahāra atikramaḥ

original: ñ349: nanu nāstitvam abhāvo 'bhāvaś ca tuccharūpas tucchena ca saha katham sambandhah; tucchasya sakala.śakti.vikalatayā sambandha.śakter apy abhāvāt /
analyzed: nanu nāstitvam abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca tuccha rūpaḥ tucchena ca saha katham sambandhaḥ tucchasya sakala śakti vikala tayā sambandha śakteḥ api abhāvāt

original: ñ: anyac ca; yadi paraparyāyāṇām tatra nāstitvam tarhi nāstitvena saha sambandho bhavatu; paraparyāyais tu saha katham sambandhah; na khalu ghaṭaḥ paṭābhāvena sambaddhaḥ paṭenāpi saha sambaddho bhavitum arhati; tathā.pratīter abhāvāt; --
analyzed: anyat ca yadi para paryāyāṇām tatra nāstitvam tarhi nāstitvena saha sambandhaḥ bhavatu para paryāyaiḥ tu saha katham sambandhaḥ na khalu ghaṭaḥ paṭa abhāvena sambaddhaḥ paṭena api saha sambaddhaḥ bhavitum arhati tathā pratīteḥ abhāvāt

original: ñ: tad etad asamīcīnam; samyag.vastu.tattvāparijñānāt; tathā hi -- nāstitvam nāma tena tena rūpeṇābhavanam(?) ca tam tam paryāyam apekṣyaiva bhavati nānyathā; tathā hi -- yo yaḥ paṭādi.gataḥ paryāyaḥ tenatena rūpeṇa mayā na bhavitavyam iti sāmarthyād ghaṭas tam tam paryāyam apekṣata iti supratītam etat; --
analyzed: tat etat asamīcīnam samyak vastu tattva aparijñānāt tathā hi nāstitvam nāma tena tena rūpeṇa abhavanam ca tam tam paryāyam apekṣya eva bhavati na anyathā tathā hi yaḥ yaḥ paṭa ādi gataḥ paryāyaḥ tena tena rūpeṇa mayā na bhavitavyam iti sāmarthyāt ghaṭaḥ tam tam paryāyam apekṣate iti su pratītam etat

original: ñ: tatas tena tena paryāyeṇābhavanasya (?) tam tam paryāyam apekṣya sambhavāt te.api paraparyāyās tasyopayogina iti tasya.iti vyapadiśyante /
analyzed: tatas tena tena paryāyeṇa abhavanasya tam tam paryāyam apekṣya sambhavāt te api para paryāyāḥ tasya upayoginaḥ iti tasya eti vyapadiśyante

original: ñ: evam.rūpāyām ca vivakṣāyām paṭo 'pi ghaṭasya sambandhī bhavaty eva; paṭam apekṣya ghaṭe patarūpeṇābhavanasya (?) bhāvāt; tathā ca laukikā api ghaṭapaṭādīn parasparam itaretarābhāvam adhikṛtya sambaddhān vyavaharanti.ity.avigītam etat /
analyzed: evamrūpāyām ca vivakṣāyām paṭaḥ ghaṭasya sambandhī bhavati eva paṭam apekṣya ghaṭe bhāvāt tathā ca laukikāḥ api ghaṭa paṭa ādīn parasparam itaretara abhāvam adhikṛtya sambaddhān vyavaharanti iti avigītam etat

original: ñ: itaś ca te paryāyās tasya.iti vyapadiśyante; svaparyāyi.viśeṣaṇatvena teṣām upayogāt / iha ye yasya svaparyāyaviśeṣakatvenopayujyate te tasya paryāyāh; yathā ghaṭasya rūpādayaḥ paryāyāḥ parasparaviśeṣakāḥ /
analyzed: itas ca te paryāyāḥ tasya eti vyapadiśyante sva paryāyi viśeṣaṇa tvena teṣām upayogāt iha ye yasya sva paryāya viśeṣaka tvena upayujyate te tasya paryāyāḥ yathā ghaṭasya rūpa ādayaḥ paryāyāḥ paraspara viśeṣakāḥ

original: ñ: upayujyante ca ghaṭasya paryāyāṇām viśeṣatayā paṭādi.paryāyāh; tān antareṇa teṣām svaparyāyavyapadeśābhāvāt; -- tathā hi -- yadi te paraparyāyā na bhaveyuḥ tarhi ghaṭasyasvaparyāyāḥ svaparyāyā ity evam na vyapadiśyeran; --
analyzed: upayujyante ca ghaṭasya paryāyāṇām viśeṣa tayā paṭa ādi paryāyāḥ tān antareṇa teṣām sva paryāya vyapadeśa abhāvāt tathā hi yadi te para paryāyāḥ na bhaveyuḥ tarhi ghaṭasya sva paryāyāḥ sva paryāyāḥ iti evam na vyapadiśyeran

original: ñ: parāpekṣayā svavyapadeśasya sadbhāvāt; tataḥ svaparyāyavyapadeśa.kāraṇatayā te.api paraparyāyās tasyopayogina iti tasya.iti vyapadiśyante / (kkk)
analyzed: para apekṣayā sva vyapadeśasya sadbhāvāt tatas sva paryāya vyapadeśa kāraṇatayā te api para paryāyāḥ tasya upayoginaḥ iti tasya eti vyapadiśyante

original: ñ: api ca; sarvam vastu pratiniyatasvabhāvam; sā ca pratiniyatasvabhāvatā pratiyogya.bhāvātmakatā.upanibandhanā /
analyzed: api ca sarvam vastu pratiniyata svabhāvam sā ca pratiniyata svabhāva tā pratiyogi abhāva ātmaka tā upanibandhanā

original: ñ: tato yāvan na pratiyogi.vijñānam bhavati tāvan nādhikṣtam vastu tad.abhāvātmakam tattvato jñātum śakyate; tathā ca sati paṭādi.paryāyāṇām api ghaṭapratiyogitvāt tad.aparijñāne ghaṭo na yāthātmyenāvagantum śakyata iti paṭādi.paryāyā api ghatasya paryāyāḥ /
analyzed: tatas yāvat na pratiyogi vijñānam bhavati tāvat na adhikṣtam vastu tad abhāva ātmakam tattvataḥ jñātum śakyate tathā ca sati paṭa ādi paryāyāṇām api ghaṭa pratiyogi tvāt tad aparijñāne ghaṭaḥ na yāthātmyena avagantum śakyate iti paṭa ādi paryāyāḥ api ghatasya paryāyāḥ

original: ñ: tathā cātra prayogaḥ -- yad anupalabdhau yasyānupalabdhiḥ sa tasya sambandhī; yathā ghaṭasya rūpādayah; paṭādi.paryāyānupalabdhau ca ghaṭasya na yāthātmyenopalalabdhir iti te tasya sambandhinaḥ / (kkk)
analyzed: tathā ca atra prayogaḥ yat anupalabdhau yasya anupalabdhiḥ sa tasya sambandhī yathā ghaṭasya rūpa ādayaḥ paṭa ādi paryāya anupalabdhau ca ghaṭasya na yāthātmyena upalabdhiḥ iti te tasya sambandhinaḥ

original: ñ: na cāyam asiddho hetuh; paṭādi.paryāyarūpapratiyogyaparijñāne tad.abhāvātmakasya ghaṭasya tattvato jñātavyāyogād iti / āha ca bhāṣyakrt --
analyzed: na ca ayam asiddhaḥ hetuḥ paṭa ādi paryāya rūpa pratiyogi aparijñāne tad abhāva ātmakasya ghaṭasya tattvataḥ jñātavya ayogāt iti āha ca bhāṣyakrt

original: ñ: ''jesu anāesu tao na najjāe najjāe ya nāeṣu /
analyzed: na najjāe najjāe ya nāeṣu

original: ñ: kiha tassa te na dhammā ghaḍasya rūvāidhammavva //1//''
analyzed: tassa te na dhammāḥ ghaḍasya

original: (yeṣv ajñāteṣu tato na jñāyate jñāyate ca jñāteṣu / katham tasya te na dharmāḥ ghaṭasya rūpādi.dharmā iva)
analyzed: yeṣu ajñāteṣu tatas na jñāyate jñāyate ca jñāteṣu katham tasya te na dharmāḥ ghaṭasya rūpa ādi dharmāḥ iva

original: ñ: tasmāt paṭādi.paryāyā api ghaṭasya sambandhina iti / paraparyāyāś ca svaparyāyebhyo 'nanta.guṇāh; ubhaye tu svaparaparyāyāḥ sarva.dravyaparyāyaparimāṇāḥ / na caitad anārṣam yata uktam ācārāGge --
analyzed: tasmāt paṭa ādi paryāyāḥ api ghaṭasya sambandhinaḥ iti para paryāyāḥ ca sva paryāyebhyaḥ nanta guṇāḥ ubhaye tu sva para paryāyāḥ sarva dravya paryāya parimāṇāḥ na ca etat anārṣam yatas uktam ācārāGge

original: ñ: ((je egam jāṇai se savvam jāṇai / je savvam jāṇai sa egam jāṇai /''
analyzed: je egam jāṇai se savvam jāṇai je savvam jāṇai sa egam jāṇai

original: ñ: asyāyam arthaḥ -- ya ekam vastu.upalabhate sarvaparyāyaiḥ sa niyamāt sarvam upalabhate; sarvopalabdhim antareṇa vivakṣitasyaikasya svaparaparyāya.bheda.bhinnatayā sarvātmanāvagantum aśakyatvāt; yaś ca sarvam sarvātmanā sākṣād upalabhate; sa ekam svaparaparyāya.bhedabhinnam jānāti; anyatrāpy uktam --
analyzed: asya ayam arthaḥ yaḥ ekam vastu upalabhate sarva paryāyaiḥ sa niyamāt sarvam upalabhate sarva upalabdhim antareṇa vivakṣitasya ekasya sva para paryāya bheda bhinna tayā sarva ātmanā avagantum aśakya tvāt yaḥ ca sarvam sarva ātmanā sākṣāt upalabhate saḥ ekam sva para paryāya bheda bhinnam jānāti anyatra api uktam

original: ñ: ''eko bhāvaḥ sarvathā yena dṛṣṭah; sarve bhāvāḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭāḥ /
analyzed: ekaḥ bhāvaḥ sarvathā yena sarve bhāvāḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭāḥ

original: ñ: sarve bhāvā srvathā yena dṛṣṭāh; eko bhāvaḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭaḥ //1//''
analyzed: sarve bhāvā srvathā yena ekaḥ bhāvaḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭaḥ

original: ñ: tataḥ siddham prameyatvād ananta.dharmātmakatvam sakalasya vastuna iti //55//
analyzed: tatas siddham prameya tvāt ananta dharma ātmaka tvam sakalasya vastunaḥ iti

original: ñ350: atha sūtra.kāra eva pratyakṣaparokṣayor lakṣaṇam lakṣayati --
analyzed: atha sūtrakāraḥ eva pratyakṣa parokṣayoḥ lakṣaṇam lakṣayati

original: ñ: aparokṣatayārthasya grāhakam jñānam īdṛśam /
analyzed: aparokṣa tayā arthasya grāhakam jñānam īdṛśam

original: ñ: pratyakṣam itaraj jñeyam parokṣam grahaṇa.īkṣayā //56//
analyzed: ñ pratyakṣam itarat jñeyam parokṣam grahaṇa īkṣayā
